title: ClimateAid: Tokenized Resilience & Early Action

solution: We’ll survey 1,500+ students at 15+ U.S. universities, use latent profile analysis to uncover gendered crypto mindsets, and create targeted strategies to boost women’s participation in Cardano.
title: Closing the Gender Gap in Cardano Through Survey Research

problem: Transport is a top CO₂ polluter. With new EU rules (CSRD), fuel & fleet card providers must report emissions—but today they lack simple, trusted systems to do so. A solution will be mission critical.
solution: Equipping fuel & fleet card providers with the blueprint to deliver effortless, trustworthy carbon transparency using Cardano, piloting with key player UTA Edenred to master the new EU CSRD rules.
title: CO₂Tracking in the Fuel & Fleet Card Industry w/ UTA Edenred

problem: CoinMRI solves two problems: DYOR is costly and hard for individuals, and crypto data (on/off chain) is centralized and expensive, limiting access for traders, analysts, and researchers.
solution: CoinMRI uses AI to analyze crypto data and charges users via utility tokens. It also enables decentralized, verifiable data provision on Cardano, rewarding both collectors and DePIN participants.
title: COINMRI

problem: No complete SDK exists for C++, preventing developers from building dApps or accessing Cardano features like transaction building, governance, and full Conway-era support.
solution: We’re building Cometa.cpp, a full-featured Cardano SDK for C++ by binding to the libcardano-c library (built for this purpose), enabling dApp development and full Conway-era interaction in C++.
title: Cometa.cpp: Cardano SDK for C++ with Full Conway Era Support

problem: No complete SDK exists for Lua, preventing developers from building dApps or accessing Cardano features like transaction building, governance, and full Conway-era support.
solution: We’re building Cometa.lua, a full-featured Cardano SDK for Lua by binding to the libcardano-c library (built for this purpose), enabling dApp development and full Conway-era interaction in Lua.
title: Cometa.lua: Cardano SDK for Lua with Full Conway Era Support

problem: No complete SDK exists for PHP, preventing developers from building dApps or accessing Cardano features like transaction building, governance, and Conway-era support
solution: We’re building Cometa.php, a full-featured Cardano SDK for PHP by binding to the libcardano-c library (built for this purpose), enabling dApp development and full Conway-era interaction in PHP.
title: Cometa.php: Cardano SDK for PHP with Full Conway Era Support

problem: No complete SDK exists for Ruby, preventing developers from building dApps or accessing Cardano features like transaction building, governance, and Conway-era support
solution: We’re building Cometa.rb, a full-featured Cardano SDK for Ruby by binding the libcardano-c library which was build for this purpose, enabling dApp development and full Conway-era interaction on Ruby
title: Cometa.rb: Cardano SDK for Ruby with Full Conway Era Support

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: Cardano currently lacks a compliant, bank-backed digital currency token. The absence of a regulated euro-equivalent token on Cardano limits enterprise adoption and real-world financial use cases.
solution: Bridge the Commercial Bank Money Token to Cardano via EVM sidechain. This provides Cardano with a compliant, bank-backed euro token for enterprise-grade transactions, like a stablecoin alternative.
title: Commercial Bank Money Token CBMT on Cardano

problem: Small and medium enterprises in emerging economies lack fair, affordable access to capital due to high risk perception, leading to stunted growth and limited economic impact.
solution: Provide membership-based fair access to capital with relatively low interest for small and middle enterprises in lucarative sectors and have a high potential in emerging economies.
title: Common Ledger: A Cardano-Based Cooperative Finance Model.

problem: Cardano's reputation and ecosystem value depend on creation and maintenance of Cardano Improvement Proposals (CIPs) through a standards process requiring dedicated attention from specialist editors.
solution: Robert Phair has 4 years experience as a confirmed CIP editor: with a demonstrated history supporting quality, accountability, high availability, and strong developer relations in the CIP process.
title: Community CIP Editor Robert Phair: 6 month budget

problem: Reading and understanding validator code is a major challenge for aspiring Cardano developers, and most open-source validators lack beginner-friendly documentation.
solution: We host open community code reviews, reading validator code line-by-line, adding clear comments, and uploading sessions to YouTube and the Datum Dons App.
title: Community Code Review: Season 2

problem: Onchain voting solves some of those issues but adds new ones, such as high fees, poor privacy, vote buying, “follow-the-crowd” pressure, and limits on how many voters it can handle.
solution: First Governance L2 on Cardano. Decentralized Open Network with Vote Integrity Network that proves every step, and Cryptographic Inference shields each ballot and the final tally.
title: Community-Owned Zero Knowledge Governance L2 + Token Economy

problem: New regulation will define most RWA tokens on-chain as securities, creating opportunities for broker dealers to issue securities on-chain, but there’s no turn-key compliance solution on Cardano.
solution: Create an open source compliance layer enabling broker dealers to customize and issue new securities as on-chain tokens while adhering to U.S. regulatory compliance.
title: Compliance Layer to Onboard $100 trillion Securities Market

problem: The lack of secure, legally structured investment opportunities in fractional ownership of agricultural businesses prevents Cardano investors from accessing high-yield (~10-24%) returns in this sector
solution: Compliant cattle feedlot tokenization. Tokens provide fractional ownership, automated dividends, 5% profit share to Cardano Treasury, and secure high-yield real-world asset investment.
title: Compliant High-Yield RWA Tokenization

problem: There are many people who want to get involved in building and operating Cardano nodes, but don't know where to start, so we found that there is a lack of formal courses.
solution: Master Cardano nodes step by step in 69 easy-to-follow lessons. Clear, practical, and designed so anyone can learn with confidence.
title: Comprehensive Course on Cardano Node Infrastructure

problem: Cardano lacks accessible tools for mainstream web developers, limiting adoption and real-world blockchain use cases.
solution: Develop Drupal modules enabling Cardano wallet integration, NFT logins, e-commerce, and asset minting for 1M+ Drupal sites.
title: Connect The Dots: Cardano Integration For Drupal

problem: London, a global hub for culture and finance, lacks regular opportunities for the Cardano community to connect. This limits collaboration, knowledge exchange, and the organic growth of our ecosystem.
solution: Organise monthly informal Cardano meetups at a central London venue, fostering community growth and networking.
title: Connect The Dots: Monthly Cardano London Meetups

problem: Rural Ghana lacks blockchain access and knowledge, limiting financial inclusion. This project trains communities, creates wallets, and drives sustainable Cardano adoption.
solution: We will establish rural Cardano hubs in Ghana to deliver education, digital identity, and financial inclusion, empowering farmers and youth with tools for fair trade and sustainable growth.
title: Connecting Rural Ghana to Cardano’s Future

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: Connecting Solana to Cardano via Rosenbridge enhances market access by enabling cross-chain transactions and liquidity through seamless interoperability and decentralized financial ecosystems.
solution: At the core of the benefits provided by Rosen Bridge is the enhancement of market access and liquidity. Rosen Bridge enables the seamless transfer of digital assets between Solana to Cardano.
title: Connecting to Solana Via RosenBridge

problem: Cardano’s DeFi ecosystem faces low visibility and adoption compared to competitors, lacking consistent influencer-driven narratives to attract new users and liquidity.
solution: Leverage top creators to amplify Cardano’s DeFi narrative: DEXs, lending, stablecoins, BTC liquidity, while optimizing strategy from previous Cardano campaigns we’ve run as part of Fund 13.
title: Content Creator DeFi Adoption Campaign

problem: Digital content today faces a trust and provenance problem: no way to verify if a piece of media actually originated from the claimed creator which leads to plagiarized media, or tampered content
solution: We will make a standard to allow content creators to sign their media (hash) verifiably on chain, an indexer and an explorer to show signatures, thus creating a tamper-proof seal on media
title: Content Origin Attestation Proposal

problem: Cardano is not well known in the enterprise IT world, which currently hinders corporate adoption.  As corporate awareness and use cases of blockchain grows, Cardano is not mentioned often enough.
solution: We will host webinars and seminars, create how to and use case videos for Salesforce decision makers and represent Cardano at events with corporate leaders in the Salesforce ecosystem.
title: Corporate Promotion of Cardano

problem: Developers struggle to test Cardano transactions and smart contracts without syncing a full node. It’s slow, complex, and blocks rapid iteration and offline development.
solution: COTS is a fast, offline CLI tool that lets developers simulate Cardano transactions and Plutus contracts without a node, with full UTXO tracking, fee calc, and export to Cardano CLI or Koios.
title: COTS-CLI: Cardano Offline Transaction Simulator

problem: Fewer than half of countries worldwide (and only ~13% in Africa) have even mapped the private lands, let alone rural areas. This lack of formal documentation excludes farmers from loans, insurance.
solution: CoVo enables communities to map parcels, issue DIDs and Verifiable Credentials to right-holders, and verify claims on Cardano through a lightweight, open-source verifier.
title: CoVo: Land Rights with Veridian DIDs, VCs & NFTs

problem: The complexity of Cardano DApp development poses barriers, slowing adoption and limiting innovation. Coxylib.js simplifies and speeds up Smart Contract development on Cardano blockchain.
solution: Coxylib.js offers streamlined, testable atomic functions for Cardano DApp development, reducing complexity, speeding up deployment, and improving accessibility for developers
title: Coxylib.js - Simplifying Cardano DApp Development

problem: Fair, trustless Poker has been a major academic problem to solve for decades. No other crypto ecosystem was able to completely solve it so far. The $100B poker industry is waiting to join us.
solution: Launch cPoker.io: the first trustless, non-custodial, real-time poker dApp integrated with Hydra and DRED, driving adoption and on-chain volume on Cardano.
title: cPoker Development

problem: Climate change impacts coffee growers, but lack of activity data prevents effective response. Producing and consuming countries face crisis without proof mechanism to verify carbon footprints(CFP).
solution: We record scientifically-calculated CFP using our proprietary technology on Midnight. This enables ①privacy protection, ②CFP data integrity, and ③transparent verification.
title: Creating Cardano Business cases through Real Coffee World

problem: Few young learners understand blockchain systems or how they interact with real world hardware, data, and business models, creating a critical skills gap in the rapidly growing blockchain industry.
solution: Launch integrated three-track program where students aged 14-21 design, build, and deploy blockchain solutions using the Cardano platform through hardware wallets and IoT sensors.
title: Creating the Blockchain Innovators of Tomorrow

problem:
The Creative economy is growing rapidly but is constrained by the following:
1.Lack of trusted identity verification of creatives
2.Poor discoverability
3.Limited opportunities (job calls, gigs, etc.)
solution:
Build a digital infrastructure for the creative economy powered by: 
1. Decentralized IDs via Atala PRISM
2. Opportuity Hub to empower creatives
3. Marketplace for discovery of creative professionals
title: Creative Atlas: Identity Solution For Onboarding Creatives

problem: There is no simple way to verify identity once and reuse it everywhere. Banks, apps, and wallets all repeat the same KYC process.
solution: We solve repeated KYC by giving people a portable, community-verified ID they can use across banks, apps, and Cardano platforms.
title: Credence

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: Pondora introduced the first general purpose DeFi smart accounts to Cardano Mainnet with initial support for trading, but additional high-value features still require audits.
solution: Funding audits for the Cross Chain accounts, DeFi Oracles, Lending and Perpetuals would accelerate the rollout of these features, greatly improving the Cardano DeFi experience.
title: Cross Chain DeFi - Perpetuals and Lending - Pondora

problem: Building Cardano dApps for web, mobile, & desktop is slow and costly. Developers lack a single toolkit, forcing them to reinvent the wheel for each platform, which stifles ecosystem growth.
solution: We will deliver an all-in-one Cardano Development Kit. A single, unified SDK with ready-to-use UI components that allows developers to build for all platforms at once, saving time and money.
title: Cross-Platform SDK: A Unified Cardano Development Kit

problem: Frontline communities with climate solutions face funding gaps due to centralized, opaque systems, limiting transparency, inclusivity, and access to global resources for climate justice.
solution: Crowd X Fund empowers donors and innovators to fund and grow climate projects transparently, inclusively, and impactfully, advancing global climate justice.
title: Crowd X for Climate Justice

problem: Fraudulent transactions on Cardano lack reliable labeling. Current methods are costly and fragmented, leaving users and developers without scalable, trustworthy fraud detection tools.
solution: Fraudulent transactions on Cardano lack reliable labeling. Current methods are costly and fragmented, leaving users and developers without scalable, trustworthy fraud detection tools.
title: Crowdsourcing AI-Powered Transaction Tagging on Cardano

problem: Most Ethiopians lack blockchain knowledge due to language barriers, leaving them excluded and vulnerable to scams.
solution: Produce a 14-week Amharic video series delivering accessible blockchain education, 2 videos weekly, to boost confidence and safe participation.
title: Crypto Confidence – A Motivational Series in Amharic

problem: The lack of knowledge about Cardano limits the ability of legal professionals in Paraguay to effectively engage with blockchain technology, resulting in missed opportunities for legal advancements
solution: This project will educate Paraguayan lawyers on the legal aspects of blockchain technology, particularly Cardano, and provide them with the knowledge to support implementation and regulation
title: Crypto Law Education for Lawyers

problem: Paraguay lacks a clear legal framework for cryptocurrencies, creating uncertainty for businesses, consumers, and innovators, and limiting Cardano’s adoption in the national economy.
solution: Draft a crypto law and gather 100,000+ verified citizen signatures to submit it as a popular initiative to Congress, ensuring legal clarity and grassroots legitimacy for Cardano adoption.
title: Crypto Legislation via Popular Petition in Paraguay

problem: Remote workers struggle to access their income from employers abroad. They experience salary delays of up to 2 weeks, high withdrawal charges of up to 15% and, the risk of local currency devaluation.
solution: A crypto payroll app that facilitates salary payment on Cardano, allowing remote workers to get paid instantly, at low fees and they receive their income in ADA or USDM to retain value.
title: Crypto Payroll on Cardano

problem: Humanitarian aid lacks transparency and accountability, with billions lost to corruption and misuse. Donor countries demand proof their funds create measurable impact, not bureaucratic waste.
solution: Blockchain-powered humanitarian aid with smart contracts ensuring transparent, milestone-based fund releases. Eliminates corruption through immutable tracking and automated compliance.
title: CryptoAid: Restoring Trust in Humanitarian Aid.

problem: Most Cardano pools rely on one pledge key. Creating keys needs cardano-cli or CNTools with a live node, blocking non-technical partners and limiting decentralization.
solution: CSPO-CLI enables secure, offline key generation without a live node, letting any partner contribute pledge easily and safely, boosting decentralization and participation.
title: CSPO-CLI: Secure, Simple Key Management for Cardano SPOs

problem: As a blockchain with +7 years of a trajectory & growing ecosystem, it's challenging for the broader Web3 audience to have a holistic and comprehensive understanding of Cardano's history.
solution:
We document and curate Cardano's most relevant milestones.
To design Cardano Timeline Infographics.
Promote them at key Web3 events.
Engaging the wider Web3 audience and drawing them to Cardano.
title: CTimelines Infographics – Promoting Cardano's History

problem: Blockchain adoption struggles due to low real-world utility, centralized systems, skill gaps and limited ethical or faith-aligned solutions, especially in emerging markets.
solution: HARVEST bridges blockchain and real-world impact via a Cardano sidechain, Sharia-compliant farm pilot, online college, apprenticeships and community-driven DAO governance.
title: Cultivating Ethical Blockchain Innovation from Africa

problem: Cardano is plagued with customer acquisition friction, complexity and lack of incentives for adoption and retention.
solution: Swift and incentivized customer acquisition of global users in the 18 - 40 year old target audience via familiar multilingual UI/UX.
title: Customer Acquisition & Ecosytem Marketing Funnel (by BETTER)

problem: d-FCT’s MVP deployed key on-chain features, but lacks full integration between smart contracts and its frontend, limiting use of the system for fact-checking, DFC token rewards, and governance actions
solution: We’ll fully integrate smart contracts into the d-FCT UI, enabling users to publish, vote, and manage rewards. UX will improve with scores, multilingual support, and optimized fact-checking flows.
title: d-FCT: Smart Contract Integration and Feature Refinement

problem:
No unified DAO hub on Cardano, making discovery and engagement fragmented.
Existing DAO tools not focus  Enterprises or NGOs.
Most platforms lack native Cardano features like minting CNT, multi-sig.
solution: D4E will deliver a multi-feature Cardano DAO platform showcasing core functions for real-world adoption by Enterprises, NGOs, and Everyone, with powerful tools like multi-sig and CNT minting.
title: D4E - DAO for Enterprise, for Everyone

problem: Blockchain has a lot of technical jargon, making it difficult to understand development and updates for a global audience, lacking exciting, easy, human-centered news that generates positive emotions.
solution: Entertaining daily breaking news and short videos on X, plus simplified aggregated news on YouTube, focused on being articulate, trustworthy, and easy-to-understand.
title: Daily X and YouTube Marketing by Angry Crypto Show

problem: Ethiopia’s dairy sector lacks transparency, leading to unfair farmer pricing, counterfeit milk, and low consumer trust due to the absence of traceability and accountability systems.
solution: A Cardano-powered platform enabling milk batch NFTs, farmer digital IDs, QR code consumer verification, and smart contract payments to ensure trust and fairness in Ethiopia’s dairy supply chain.
title: Dairy Supply Chain Transparency Platform

problem: Cardano GraphQL allows for custom queries and less API calls. With network growth it's performance and maintainance became a problem. We want to offer a modern redesign as devs and students needs it.
solution: A single GraphQL API for all things Cardano: Blockfrost, YaCi and a modern, simpler and maintainance-friendly redesign of Cardano GraphQL API
title: Dandelion: new CardanoGraphQL+Blockfrost+Yaci over GraphQL

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: As the world's go-to destination for tracking on-chain activity, DappRadar provides a powerful distribution platform to make the Cardano ecosystem discoverable to a global audience.
solution: Launch a Cardano ecosystem hub on DappRadar's platform, using transparent data to validate ecosystem growth, enhance global credibility, and drive measurable mainstream adoption.
title: DappRadar:Discovery Platform for Cardano Mainstream Adoption

problem: Interacting with Cardano datums is hindered by low-level CBOR encoding, requiring expertise. Datum Explorer helps, but needs upgrades for flexibility, usability, and broader on-chain data support.
solution: We will enhance the open-source Datum Explorer with advanced display, editing, and integration features, adding tools like browser extensions, history, error reporting, and external schema integration
title: Datum Explorer: Advanced CBOR tools & Interactive Features

problem: DCOne solves the need to use many platforms for price tracking, token swaps, and wallet monitoring by building integrated, user-friendly, and optimized tools.
solution: DCOne builds an integrated DeFi ecosystem on Cardano with Swap and Telegram Bot, upgrading UI, optimizing smart routing, and adding wallet monitoring with price alerts.
title: DCOne Swap Aggregator

problem: Lack of tooling for community finance limits real-world Cardano adoption preventing developers from building solutions for secure credit, governance and transparency in traditional savings groups.
solution: DCU : A proof-of-concept enabling community savings groups to operate on Cardano with automated transparency, governance, and fund management, unlocking Africa's cooperative finance market and beyond.
title: DCU : Decetralized Credit Unions Toolkit on Cardano

problem: Governance today is fragmented—apps rebuild identity, mandates are siloed, and trust is weak. Communities need portable, verifiable group identity.
solution: Decentralised governance with Verifiable Credentials lets communities control identities, simplify logins, and enable secure voting—starting with Whangaroa Papa Hapū the tribal community in Aotearoa.
title: Decentralised Voting and Authentication System

problem: The absence of a decentralized platform for efficiently exchanging recycled or upcycled materials results in waste build-up, hampering efforts to establish a sustainable, smart, circular economy.
solution: Develop a decentralized smart marketplace on Cardano that enable reputation based peer-to-peer exchange of recycled goods, with smart contracts ensuring trust & NFT-based sustainability certifications
title: Decentralized Circular Economy Marketplace

problem: Most crowdfunding platforms don’t protect donors. Funds are misused, and there’s no refund if goals fail. No Cardano DApp offers milestone or refund-based protection.
solution: We’re building a Cardano DApp where donations are only released after milestone checks. If goals aren’t met by the deadline, donors are automatically refunded on-chain.
title: Decentralized Crowdfunding DApp for Transparent Funding

problem: Cardano developers and users lack a reliable,open-source escrow tool.Without it,trust in peer-to-peer payments is limited,hindering adoption of decentralized commerce and developer-led financial apps.
solution: An open-source escrow framework on Cardano will empower developers to integrate secure  payments into dApps,while providing users with transparent,affordable alternatives to centralized escrow.
title: Decentralized Escrow Service on Cardano

problem: "In LATAM, most people lack basic knowledge of decentralized finance, limiting adoption and opportunities in the Cardano ecosystem.
solution: Create a beginner-friendly DeFi course in LATAM, inspired by InvestIn, to teach finance basics and onboard new users to Cardano
title: Decentralized Finance Course for Beginners

problem: Cardano governance actions require a 100k ADA deposit, excluding many capable participants. No transparent, easy-to-use borrowing mechanism exists.
solution: Build a testnet MVP that enables borrowing 100k ADA from Danogo pools, submitting proposals via Tempo, and repaying with pre-calculated fees.
title: Decentralized Governance Lending for On-chain GAs

problem: Centralized medical records are prone to breaches, data loss, and lack secure authentication. Patients lack control over personal info, leading to privacy risks and limited transparency.
solution: We will build a decentralized ID app using SSI to let patients securely manage, control, and share their medical data solving data leaks, poor access, and lack of transparency.
title: Decentralized Identity for Health Record Management

problem: The global education system lacks trust: forged credentials, siloed records, opaque instructor pay, no real-time policy insights and unverifiable skills hinder learners, employers, and society.
solution: Our platform is designed to enable secure, verifiable, and evolving learner and educator credentials through blockchain technology.
title: decentralized Learning Management System_Knowledge Ledger

problem: We want to solve the encrypted NFT problem by creating a decentralized protocol for encrypting arbitrary data, where only the owner may decrypt the data, all the while maintaining tradability.
solution: We will develop a decentralized data encryption protocol on Cardano, enabling secure NFT data encryption and decryption without relying on centralized services or preventing tradability of the NFT.
title: Decentralized On-Chain Data Encryption

problem: Elections in emerging democracies lack trust due to rigging and opacity, causing instability. A secure, transparent, and verifiable voting system is urgently needed to restore faith in democracy.
solution: A Cardano-based voting system using DIDs for secure registration and smart contracts for a transparent, encrypted, and tamper-proof vote count that anyone can publicly verify.
title: Decentralized Presidential Voting System

problem: Ride-hailing apps in Ethiopia lack a universal two-way rating system. Ratings are not portable, letting bad actors switch apps to get a clean slate, creating a flawed and insecure trust model.
solution: We will build an open-source Cardano dApp with Plutus smart contracts and DIDs to create a universal, two-way, and portable reputation system for ride-hailing users, compliant with local laws.
title: Decentralized Ride-Sharing Reputation System for Ethiopia

problem: We are solving the problem of instability and reliance on centralized stablecoins in DeFi which hinders fairer access to liquidity, trading, and payments across the ecosystem.
solution: To safeguard financial confidentiality and autonomy while ensuring  stability, and transparency through verified smart contracts by enabling users to mint a USD-pegged coin backed by crypto assets.
title: Decentralized Stablecoin Protocol On Midnight

problem: Defense and aerospace face complex supply chains, legacy silos, and strict security needs, causing inefficiencies and trust issues in collaboration, traceability, and data sharing.
solution: INVENSITY GmbH launches a Blockchain & Cardano Awareness Program for defense and aerospace with workshops, training, and roadmaps to boost supply chain security, data integrity, and trust.
title: Defense & Aerospace Blockchain Security Initiative

problem: Decentralized Finance on Cardano remains inaccessible to average users due to complex interfaces, fragmented tools, and lack of automated risk management.
solution: A portfolio management system that makes DeFi accessible to everyday people through transaction categorization and simple dashboards, establishing a foundation for future automated DeFi tooling.
title: DeFi Buddy: Simplifying DeFi for Everyone

problem: Cardano DeFi is fragmented across DEXs, lending, perps, and analytics. A single hub is needed to unify access and onboard users, especially as Cardano targets Bitcoin DeFi
solution: A single dashboard unifying Cardano’s DeFi protocols via an open integration framework, enabling easy access, standardised data, and protocol self-integration
title: DeFi Hub - One Open Standard, All Cardano DeFi in One Place

problem: In republican systems, regulation has focused on legislation, but little effort has been made to engage the judiciary, submit cases, and establish jurisprudence on on-chain payments and contracts.
solution: We propose taking on-chain disputes to court to establish the first favorable jurisprudence on blockchain, focusing on Cardano and setting legal precedent for the industry.
title: Defining the First Jurisprudential Milestones for Cardano

problem: Blockchain awareness among senior high school students in Ghana is low,limiting early adoption and innovation.Without targeted education, Cardano risks losing a future generation of ecosystem leaders.
solution: Train teachers, engage students with blockchain learning, launch “Cardano Clubs,” and host competitions to build a scalable, sustainable, and vibrant Cardano youth community in Ghana.
title: DeLotus Academy:Cardano Education for High School Innovators

problem: Fair, broad access to rare and somewhat complicated collectibles like art, wine, cars. Challanges: storage, maintenance, liquidity, deep knowledge, connections, trust.
solution: An association with experts' leadership that buys real assets, tokenizes them. Members' contributions are represented by NFTs. NFTs serve as access token to gatherings and services.
title: Democratizing Collecting: Association-Based Access Model

problem: Smart contract DApps must build off-chain executors to prevent UTXO contention, but teams repeatedly rebuild stacks, slowing delivery and increasing operational risks from ad-hoc implementations.
solution: DApps on Cardano waste time rebuilding the same off-chain code to handle UTXO contention. This Golang template saves time and helps new projects get to market faster.
title: Deploy Faster on Cardano: Open-Source Off-Chain Engine

problem: Although Cardano is founded on peer-reviewed science, it lacks an academic forum. The Desci Cardano Symposium will convene scholars to produce, review, and publish research on Cardano.
solution: A symposium in Argentina will unite labs and blockchain centers to present research, with universities competing for monetary prizes, fostering academic excellence in Cardano.
title: DeSci Cardano Symposium

problem: Hiring skilled developers or finding the right collaborators in the Cardano ecosystem is time-consuming and uncertain. CVs are self-reported and offer no cryptographic proof of actual contributions
solution: DevCreds issues ACDC credentials for developers, generated from verified GitHub activity and stored in Cardano-Veridian wallets. The credentials are cryptographically verifiable using a SDK.
title: DevCreds: Verifiable Developer Badges for Cardano

problem: Resources are scattered across dozens of sites (IOG docs, community tutorials, GitHub repos, blogs), forcing developers to manually piece together incomplete information from multiple sources.
solution: Single platform that AI-synthesizes fragmented Cardano documentation into clean, comprehensive guides with conversational support.
title: DevHub: All Cardano Resources, One Platform

problem: SPOs must juggle infrastructure, performance, security, monitoring, and evolving best practices. Many SPOs are solo or part-time operators who can't watch their node 24/7 or interpret every metric.
solution: This assistant acts like a 24/7 DevOps engineer. It can help automate all major tasks needed to sustain a stake pool over time.
title: DevOps Assistant for SPOs Autonomous Stake Pool Ops

problem: We want to build a strong Cardano developer network across Africa, starting in Nigeria. The goal is to help teams go beyond the bootcamp and turn their ideas into real products that grow the ecosystem
solution: We’re gamifying Cardano dev onboarding in Nigeria through a bootcamp, builder challenge, and reality YouTube series to attract top talent and launch real products on Cardano.
title: DevX Code & Conquer Series: Powered by Cardano

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: Cardano DeFi lacks advanced order types like stop loss, take profit, OCO, and DCA. Development isn't viable due to low usage and audit costs, limiting traders' risk management tools.
solution: Introduce advanced order types like stop loss, take profit, OCO, and DCA with min-max price ranges on DexHunter to empower traders with better risk management and automated trading.
title: DexHunter Advanced Order Types

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: Cardano DeFi lacks engaging user retention features, leading to low trading activity and poor user engagement compared to other ecosystems with gamification.
solution: Add gamification features to DexHunter including profit leaderboards, daily rewards, achievements, and social elements to boost user engagement and trading activity.
title: DexHunter Gamify: Enhancing User Engagement via Gamification

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: While DexHunter provides excellent UX, users still rely on external wallets for trading, which can be cumbersome and slow. We must improve the UX by allowing faster, more seamless in-platform trading.
solution: Adding an in-platform balance with non-custodial smart contracts lets users trade faster, avoid wallet delays, and enjoy seamless one-click swaps directly in DexHunter.
title: DexSwift

problem: DiamondHooves CNFT community lacks secure AI chatbots for personalized engagement, limiting interaction and growth. We aim to optimize CNFT engagement in DiamondHooves with private personalization.
solution: Our solution, HarmonyAI, delivers secure & private chatbots to DiamondHooves, boosting NFT engagement and interaction in a unique Cardano use-case. This is scalable across the entire CNFT ecosystem.
title: DiamondHooves<>Adaxon: Elevating NFTs with Private Chatbots

problem: Business chambers lack secure, digital tools for transparent governance. Current voting is slow, outdated, and excludes many members from real participation in decision-making.
solution: A mobile app for DIG members, built on modified Cardano Ballot. It enables tenure-weighted voting, transparent governance, and delivers member benefits like special offers, discounts and event RSVPs
title: DIG Governance App: Blockchain Voting for Business Chambers

problem: Smallholder farmers lack verifiable identity and trusted farm data. This makes them "invisible" to lenders and insurers, blocking their access to credit, insurance, and premium markets.
solution: Link FieldNFTs to farmer DIDs, add FieldScore credit and parametric insurance oracles, and integrate Landano/Commonlands/ZenGate to unlock finance, protection, and traceability on Cardano.
title: DigiFarm Credit & Climate Passport

problem: Tanzania's national agriculture programs are hindered by siloed, inaccurate data. A verifiable, interoperable data foundation is needed to unlock digital financial services for smallholder farmers.
solution: We will pilot a "Digital Agriculture Blueprint" for 1,000 farmers in Tanzania, using FieldNFTs on Cardano to create a trusted data layer aligned with UNCDF's national digitization strategy.
title: Digital Agriculture Blueprint for Tanzania

problem: Global regulatory gaps in DeFi, AI-assets, stablecoins, and tokenized assets slow adoption. DARTE Series 2.0 connects policymakers, regulators, and innovators through global high-level roundtables.
solution: DARTE will host 5 global roundtables, incl. the U.S. Capitol & UNIDROIT, using a trusted Catalyst-backed format to unite regulators & Web3 experts on legal gaps and crypto policy alignment.
title: Digital Assets Roundtable Series 2.0

problem: Despite earning more than a million dollars in a lifetime, most cannot afford a funeral, forcing many to go into debt. A 400 year old model in private hands, is rigged to be costly.
solution: Cee4L converts everyday spending into a funeral benefit on Cardano, using a dynamic loyalty NFT, as a verifiable claim. Its hybrid blockchain model ensures a free funeral benefit, a utility forever.
title: Digital Loyalty Card for Free Funerals - Cardano NFTs, RWA

problem: We want to improve the current situation regarding the sales of second hand vehicles. Ritgh now this industry lacks the trust nedeed from both buyers and sellers.
solution: We will tokenize tasks (maintenance, service intervals and repair), creating a tamper-proof digital vehicle passport & documenting it's life cycle. It will be public, truthful, lasting and immutable.
title: Digital Owner's Handbook - A digital passport for vehicles

problem: Many Ctrl Wallet users don’t know the full range of Cardano’s features available, limiting adoption and ecosystem visibility.
solution: We will produce 5 short, viral videos showcasing key Cardano features in Ctrl Wallet, distributed via Twitter, Discord, and Telegram with $ADA reward campaigns.
title: Discover Cardano with Ctrl Wallet – Short Video Series

problem: Document digitalization relies heavily on costly X.509 certificates. While Cardano could provide a great alternative, legal uncertainty is slowing down Web3 adoption.
solution: Our Professor and lawyers perform a legal and academic analysis, followed by a publication in academic journal to clarify opportunities offered by global and regional key regulations (focus on eIDAS).
title: Disrupting X.509: Building Legal Arguments for Cardano

problem: Unmonitored distribution transformer loads lead to failures and frequent overloads at PLN Makassar, Indonesia. Centralized monitoring data is vulnerable to manipulation.
solution: Providing an IoT-based system to read current and voltage indicators on distribution transformers and send the data to the ipfs server and utilize the cardano blockchain to be secure and immutable.
title: Distribution Transformer Monitoring using Cardano and IoT

problem: Aquariums, terrariums and similar hobbies rarely have a link to environmental action. Today, there’s no simple way for enthusiasts to make meaningful contributions to preserving the ecosystems they ❤️
solution: A Cardano-powered module in DomuLabs devices enabling automatic donations, transparently managed through smart contracts.
title: DomuLabs 🌱 — Environmental IoT with Cardano Donations

problem: Real-world ownership web-2 systems are slow, fraud-prone, and hard to verify—lacking a secure, decentralized method for proving and transferring asset ownerships.
solution: Create secure, tokenized proof of ownership using Cardano smart contracts and NFTs—enabling fast, verifiable asset transfer with legal binding and identity integration.
title: DPOPA - Digital Proof of Ownership for Assets

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: From 2027, EU imported products will require a Digital Product Passport under ESPR, with Distributed Ledger Technology ensuring data integrity. Reliable tools are essential for global trade access.
solution: A Cardano-powered platform enabling manufacturers to issue EU-compliant Digital Product Passports with minimal cost, supported by government (MDED) and industry partners.
title: DPP - Compliant Onchain European Digital Product Passport

problem: As decision-making moves on-chain to ADA holders, informed discussion of our community’s values becomes critical. Nobody can read all relevant papers, and off-the-shelf LLMs know little about Cardano.
solution: Custom-trained Governance, Values & Enterprise AI Assistant trained on unbiased Cardano-native data. Vital support for DReps to safeguard Treasury in Voltaire Era. Support for Reeve treasury and SPOs.
title: DRep AI Assistant: Support for Governance, SPOs and Reeve

problem: Cardano’s funding process is too complex for small teams. DReps must vote on all proposals, it is tiresome to vote for minor ones. No way to lower requested funds or let others offer cheaper delivery.
solution: A DRep DAO platform open to all DReps and teams could enable streamlined handling of small funding requests, making the process more accessible, efficient, and inclusive for the Cardano ecosystem.
title: DRep DAO Platform

problem: DReps lack a unified tool that allows them to understand Cardano's networtk statistics, their own metrics, and how the governance process evolves for them as a representative body.
solution: A dedciated console that aggregates all the information DReps require to fulfill their roles. Also, a transparency tool for the community in the form of an online console.
title: DRep Governance Console

problem: Over 1400 DReps are registered but fewer than 300 consistently vote. Participation is hindered by limited knowledge, no incentives, and lack of mentorship support
solution: We will test a community-based mentorship program where experienced DReps guide newcomers and earn incentives, validating whether this model boosts active participation.
title: DRep Mentorship Circle: Peer-to-Peer Governance Growth Model

problem: Africans face hurdles in Cardano governance. Information on dReps and delegation is scarce and in English, causing disengagemen and poor participation in Voltaire.
solution: A mobile-first, no code hub with 50+ dRep profiles (bios, values, voting summaries), 20+ intro videos and delegation guides. A Find Your Match quiz and wallet QR how-to-docs make it easy to delegate.
title: dRep of Africa: Local Profile Hub and Delegator Guide

problem: Many people are interested in becoming DReps but hesitate because they feel unprepared. Many DReps lack a clear understanding of how Cardano governance works. It slows the decentralization progress.
solution: As a DRep training leader, I created a presentation that participants found easy to understand. I would like to organize the DRep training again.
title: DRep Online Training

problem: New DReps need help to quickly understand proposals, check cost realism, & articulate positions with evidence. Without assistance & structure, participation skews to power users & many voters abstain.
solution: Build AI Chief of Staff Agent suite: core agent w/ cited summaries, risk flags, memos; oversees 4 sub-agents—Research, Comms, Ops, Governance. Toolkit + EN/ES guides + workshops. Other tools in Beta
title: DRep Voting Management Platform—Your AI Congressional Staff

problem: Without defensible thresholds for DRep voting power saturation, Cardano governance risks disproportionate influence by a few actors, reduced diversity, and underrepresentation of emerging regions.
solution: We will analyze DRep voting power and regional ADA distribution, model saturation options, assess governance feasibility, and deliver open data, simulations, and policy recommendations.
title: dRep Voting Power Saturation Research

problem: African youth rarely meet blockchain governance in school. Without early, relatable practice in delegation and on-chain voting, they risk being left out of Cardano’s decision-making.
solution: A non-technical program delivering governance bootcamps, student dRep elections, delegation simulations, and a no-code public microsite for 1,000+ students in Africa.
title: dRep4Schools - Student Leadership Meets Cardano Governance

problem: Most ADA holders struggle to choose DReps due to lack of clarity, accessible tools, and value alignment data. Active ADA participation remains low, and DRep voting power concentration is raising
solution: drep.space will be a governance matching tool that helps ADA holders delegate based on shared values with DReps. Through a Vision Quiz, the platform aims to simplify governance & DRep discoverability
title: drep.space – MVP Validation of Governance Matching Tool

problem: Many newcomers find blockchain education dull and inaccessible. Cardano lacks engaging, gamified onboarding experiences that attract and retain new users from diverse, non-technical communities.
solution: We will launch a gamified “military-style bootcamp” that teaches Cardano basics through missions, challenges, and teamwork, making onboarding fun, engaging, and accessible to new communities.
title: Drill & Deploy: Military-Style Gamified Onboarding Bootcamp

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: Sports lack real blockchain adoption: fan tokens are speculative, NFTs isolated, fans lack wallets and governance, and youth miss verifiable education. No scalable, utility-driven use case exists
solution: We want to integrate ADA into Miami FC audience via fan tokens, NFT tickets, academy blockchain labs, and stadium onboarding, creating wallets, on-chain governance, education, and mass adoption
title: Driving Mainstream Cardano Adoption via Soccer w/ Miami FC

problem: Property rights are often insecure and inefficiently managed; blockchain recordkeeping improves trust and efficiency, but dynamic, reliable management of rights on-chain must be improved for users.
solution:
We will create a user-friendly application that dynamically responds to real-world user desires to:
-Manage and update rights attached to properties 
-Transfer rights to properties between parties
title: Dynamic Property Rights Management on Cardano

problem: currently there are limited platforms for both earning through microtasks and outsourcing small jobs. Existing solutions lack transparency, have high fees and don't offer a simple payment solutions.
solution:
A web-based marketplace where:
 -Task Doers earn ADA by completing microtasks
 -Task Posters pay ADA to get tasks completed
 -All transactions secured by Cardano smart contracts
title: Earning through Microtasks: A Cardano Based Earning Platform

problem: Not every founder is VC-ready, and not every project wants institutional VC. Boutique and SME teams still need room to grow. They are too often missing from marketing proposals and incubator programs.
solution: Since 2022, our Fireside Chats, X-Spaces, NFTweekend & Blueprints serve as platform for practical knowledge exchange & grwoth, connecting new and established founders. Without funding the program ends
title: ECC Founder Hub – Continuation of European Cardano Community

problem: Millions of trauma survivors risk losing their stories to paper loss or data leaks. They deserve a safe, private home for their health and healing one that protects dignity and ownership for life.
solution: EchoSafe is a privacy first dApp for trauma survivors to securely record medical and emotional recovery data on Cardano and IPFS, giving them full control and ownership of their healing journey.
title: EchoSafe: A Cardano dApp Securing Medical and Mental Health

problem: Paper reliance drives deforestation and waste. Current systems lack sustainable, blockchain-backed digital alternatives for secure, eco-friendly record management.
solution: To develop a blockchain-based platform replacing paper with secure, eco-friendly digital records, reducing deforestation and promoting sustainability.
title: EcoChain: A Paperless Solutions on Cardano

problem: Lack of MRV-grade, tamper-evident geospatial data on Cardano limits adoption in carbon, agriculture, and climate projects. Fund 12 proved concept; now we must meet MRV standards at scale.
solution: Scale EcoMandala to MRV-grade dynamic H3 NFTs with verified updates, AI-enhanced satellite data, API v2, and partner integration for carbon and climate project verification.
title: EcoMandala v.2 – On-chain Environmental Intelligence

problem: Accra faces severe plastic pollution affecting health and environment. Schools generate much waste but lack systems and motivation for recycling, worsening the city’s plastic crisis.
solution: Organise an incentivized program to teach students to recycle, creating positive impact, reducing waste, promoting sustainable, eco-friendly habits
title: EcoRewards: Motivating Plastic Recycling in Accra Schools

problem: Communities lack clear, visual insight into how local actors, tools, and proposals interconnect—slowing adoption, coordination, and utility development on Cardano.
solution: We'll create a visual, interactive ecosystem map using real user data, test it with Starch miners and Japan, and refine it through feedback loops and self-reporting tools.
title: Ecosystem Mapping for Community-Led Utility & Layer-2

problem: In Afar, high school students lack access to modern technology and blockchain education, limiting their understanding of cryptocurrencies and hindering their engagement with economic opportunities.
solution: We propose a decentralized education program to teach Afar high school students about Cardano and blockchain, empowering them with essential skills for future economic opportunities.
title: Educating Local High School Students in Afar about Cardano

problem: Potential RWI:Quality education needs technology advancement, the majority of Indonesian population necessity as fundamental that could require transparency, accessibility, and a fair ecosystem.
solution:
Create and track a donation system managing funds from boarding schools 
Generate teaching application modules as an extracurricular in Islamic boarding schools to attract the student's interest
title: Educational Revolution: DApp Integration for Boarding School

problem: Ethiopian schools use paper records that are easily lost or falsified, limiting students’ access to opportunities.
solution: EduChain Lite anchors school records on Cardano, giving students tamper-proof, portable histories and enabling schools and verifiers to issue and confirm records securely and quickly
title: EduChain: A Decentralized Education Record System for School

problem: Cardano lacks fun, casual, community-driven games to attract new users and showcase NFT utility.
solution: Egg Wars is a Worms-inspired arcade game where players control babySNEKs in turn-based battles. NFT-based skins, weapons, and tournament modes integrate on-chain assets with fun-first gameplay.
title: Egg Wars – A Worms-Style Web3 Game

problem: The current message signing standard on Cardano (CIP-8) only supports signing raw text. It lacks structure, and type definitions—meaning users have no way to understand what they’re signing or why.
solution: Implement structured, typed message signing for Cardano, inspired by EIP-712, to improve security, usability, and support for dApps, L2s, and governance protocols.
title: EIP-712 Typed structured data signing for Cardano

problem: Large scale on-chain voting on Cardano Layer 1 is neither cost-effective nor fast.
solution: Leveraging Hydra state channels allows governance participants to engage in high-frequency voting while ensuring that results are verifiable on-chain achieving a hybrid solution for sentiment polling.
title: Ekklesia: High-Frequency Voting on Cardano with Hydra

problem: Circular economy projects/businesses, like those at Enactus, lack verifiable proof of impact. This makes it difficult to attract premium buyers, secure funding, and scale operations efficiently.
solution: We will build Eko-Chain, a dApp using evolving NFTs to track a product's lifecycle from waste to final good. It will feature a marketplace for verified products and a public impact dashboard.
title: Eko-Chain: A Proof of Impact Protocol for Circular Economies

problem: Electronics and sensor makers face risks from counterfeit parts, insecure IoT data, and complex supply chains, needing blockchain expertise for authenticity, integrity, and trust
solution: INVENSITY GmbH offers workshops, training, and roadmaps to help electronics & sensor industries integrate Cardano blockchain, boosting component provenance, data security, and supplychain transparency
title: Electronics & Sensors Blockchain Integration Program

problem: Untapped developer community of BEAM developers with experience in building massively concurrent and resilient distributed systems can't build on Cardano due to missing protocol libraries.
solution: Develop an Elixir client library for Ouroboros networking protocols, enabling Cardano development in Elixir and on the Erlang VM (aka BEAM)
title: Elixir client for Ouroboros networking protocol

problem: Qualified people and orgs in healthcare can’t easily verify or match skills due to fragmented, analogue systems—blocking access, mobility, and urgent response in local and global labor markets.
solution: Emaji is building a Cardano credential wallet that, together with groups like the Red Cross and LinkedIn, lets people prove and connect their skills directly to trusted jobs - locally and globally.
title: Emaji: Trusted Wallet for Healthcare Workforce Innovation

problem: Young African footballers face lack of career support, limited facilities, financial struggles, and contract issues, hindering their growth and opportunities globally.
solution: A Cardano-powered platform for African youth footballers with a transparent ecosystem for skill verification, equitable contracts, scout networking, and comprehensive career assistance
title: Empowering African Youth Football via Cardano Blockchain

problem: Communities face unreported small but high-impact issues like potholes or broken street-lights. With no incentives and slow, fragmented reporting, problems grow costly and cities struggle to respond.
solution: SenseEarn_Report uses Smart Contracts + Hydra to batch micro-payments, rewarding citizens with tokens for reporting public issues, boosting civic pride and saving cities money.
title: Empowering Citizens to Improve Cities – Powered by Hydra

problem: Cardano education in Ethiopia is slow, text heavy, and not engaging. Content fails to keep pace with fast ecosystem updates, leaving newcomers uninformed and unmotivated.
solution: Produce short, engaging videos in Amharic and Afaan Oromo, updated quickly, to simplify Cardano and make learning accessible for all Ethiopians.
title: Empowering Ethiopia with Cardano: Engaging Video Education

problem: Great difficulty for young footballers with great potential to fund their careers. Funding mechanisms are currently monopolized in very few hands. Clubs and communities lose retention and value.
solution: Through Cardano, fans and communities invest in a % of players’ image income in the world’s most popular sport—Argentina’s star powerhouse—with transparent payouts in ADA or native stablecoins
title: Empowering Future Stars: Cardano Footballer Tokens

problem: Despite onboarding 150 youths in 3 regions, many other regions remain unreached. Expanding to other regions will bridge the gap and grow youth engagement with Cardano and Project Catalyst in Ghana.
solution: Host three Cardano activation events in three new regions onboarding 150 youths through education, wallet setup, and Catalyst participation to expand the ecosystem’s reach in Ghana.
title: Empowering Ghanaian Youths through Cardano Blockchain 2.0

problem: Cardano lacks accessible, project-based learning for formal verification; fostering Lean talent can boost ecosystem growth and blockchain security worldwide.
solution: Create a special interest group to develop project-based Lean courses, fostering talent in formal verification and growing Cardano’s ecosystem through education and community.
title: Empowering Global Cardano Growth with Lean Education

problem: Hawassa lacks blockchain education and resources, limiting local talent, innovation, and opportunities to contribute to the Cardano ecosystem.
solution: Establish a Cardano Hub in Hawassa to provide education, resources, and community support, empowering local talent and fostering blockchain innovation.
title: Empowering Hawassa: A Cardano Blockchain Innovation Hub

problem: Ethiopian students lack access to Cardano education and mentorship, missing skills and opportunities to create real blockchain solutions or participate in global innovation programs.
solution: We will deliver a bilingual English & Amharic Cardano focused blockchain program for Ethiopian high schoolers, blending workshops, digital tools, and teacher training to build future ready skills.
title: Empowering High Schoolers to Lead in Cardano

problem: Most citizens in Japan still don’t know what ADA is, how it works, or why it matters. Cardano lacks daily-life visibility and cultural trust, limiting grassroots adoption.
solution: We will make ADA part of daily life in Japan by embedding it into festivals, radio, and LINE — turning blockchain into something trusted, joyful, and culturally familiar.
title: Empowering Real-World ADA Adoption with Ashiya Pool

problem: Lack of early exposure to blockchain means most African teenage girls never consider careers or innovation in Web3.
solution: Introducing blockchain to teen girls through workshops, mentorship, and hands-on Cardano projects, fostering future Web3 leaders.
title: Empowering  Teenage Girls into Blockchain with Cadrano

problem: While the majority of Ethiopian youth pursue skills-based TVET education, most Cardano initiatives target universities, leaving these practical learners without access to blockchain tools and benefit.
solution: We’ll train Ethiopia’s skills-based TVET students in Cardano blockchain, enabling them to build real-world projects, access funding, and create economic opportunities.
title: Empowering TVET Students with Cardano Skills

problem: Limited participation of women in Africa’s blockchain ecosystem prevents equitable access to opportunities, slowing Cardano adoption and ecosystem growth.
solution: Launch mentorship, scholarship, and skill-building programs empowering women and minorities to participate in blockchain, fostering diversity, inclusion, and Cardano ecosystem expansion.
title: Empowering Women in Blockchain

problem: Many women in Ghana struggle to access knowledge on blockchain and business support, this limits their opportunities to join the growing tech and Cardano communities and to build successful ventures.
solution: We’ll create women-led hubs in Ghana to teach blockchain, offer mentorship, and support women in building their own businesses, helping them thrive in the Cardano community.
title: Empowering Women in Ghana: Cardano Hubs for Blockchain & Biz

problem: Native wallets have limited functionality when accounting for current account use cases.  There is no native support for recurring payments and fund recovery if seed phrase is lost.
solution: With urble, we are a building a new savings account architecture with on-chain current accounts allowing for regular rule-based contributions and fund recovery.
title: Enabling current accounts in urble

problem: Cardano's eUTxO model and Plutus are powerful but complex; Aiken helps, but lacks tools for rapid offchain prototyping and validation,developers are error-prone, hence leading to slow adoptions.
solution: Build an open Managed Chain protocol server for code generation, eUTxO modeling, and script auditing in Aiken provide a standardized way to generate, validate,and manage transaction contexts off-chain
title: Enhanced MCP Server for Aiken-Plutus Development on eUTxO

problem: Cardano has 1-on-1 discussions but needs an ongoing agent to engage with Enterprises, stay up to date with their priorities, and promote Cardano projects.
solution: Include Cardano into STORM Partners’ enterprise adoption program as an active participant, creating reports and hosting events for large institutions as well as promoting Cardano use cases.
title: Enterprise Events, BD & Partnerships - STORM Partners

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem:
MAKING CARDANO READY FOR ENTERPRISE & GOVERNMENT ADOPTION.
Cardano lacks an audit-grade verifiable database. Enterprises can’t prove off‑chain integrity at volume,compliance,TVL, real‑world adoption.
solution: zkDatabase (mainnet): ZK‑rollups compress millions of ops into 1 proof, verified in <500 ms, 300× cheaper, enterprise ready. Allow on-chain systems to access an unlimited amount of off-chain data
title: Enterprise-grade Verifiable Database,300x cheaper, 99%faster

problem: Web3 builders and projects often struggle to work with traditional enterprises and NGOs, which might have complex structures, rules against using tokens, and other restrictions.
solution: STORM Partners will provide contract review, project management, on & off-ramp, Web3 education, and other facilitation services to help Cardano enterprise adoption projects succeed.
title: Enterprise Support for Cardano Adoption - STORM Partners

problem: Cardano lacks real-world projects that showcase tokenized ownership and utility of phisical spaces. There are no tokenized workspace on Cardano to bridge the chain with everyday experiences.
solution: Tokenizing Sova, HCM Co-working on Cardano, enabling shared ownership, utility, and real-world adoption and creating new financial oppurtunities for ADA holders and bringing more SMEs onchain.
title: Entire Co-working Space Tokenized - Sova, HCM on Cardano

problem: Cardano lacks real-world projects showing tokenized ownership of physical spaces. No tokenized bar exists in Hanoi to bridge blockchain with daily experiences.
solution: Tokenizing Sova Hanoi Cocktail Bar on Cardano, enabling shared equity, real-world adoption, and new financial opportunities for ADA holders while bringing SMEs on-chain.
title: Entire Cocktail Bar Equity as Cardano RWAs  - Sova Hanoi

problem: We are addressing the problem of the critical lack of reliable & sustainable electricity in remote regions in Africa which severely hampers local economic development and educational opportunities.
solution: Portable smart solar systems for rural Africa, using Cardano to prove ownership and transparently track energy generation, usage, and system performance.
title: Eonpower: Cardano-Backed Solar Energy Solutions For Africa

problem: Student blockchain clubs across Europe work in isolation. Without a hub, collaboration and Cardano awareness among Erasmus and university students remain fragmented.
solution: We build an online hub linking Erasmus and EU student clubs, sharing resources, hosting virtual events, and fostering Cardano collaboration across universities.
title: Erasmus Blockchain Club Network

problem: Even in Europe, the Green New Deal movement is receeding, and is being challenged from all sides. Even technical superior solutions don't make it to the surface of mainstream discussions anymore.
solution: Organizing a 1dayl conference of thought leaders & decision makers, where blockchain-based & other exponential tech solutions are presented + publishing a list of proven solutions for key problems
title: ESG Masters - a tech for sustainability conference format

problem: South East Nigeria lacks local access to web3 education hubs, despite high concentration of tech talents. Grassroots outreach is needed for Cardano adoption and ecosystem growth in the region.
solution: Establish Blockchain Hub Africa as Cardano-focused community hub in Enugu to provide Web3 education, host events, and drive Cardano grassroot adoption among local developers, students, and founders.
title: Establishing Cardano Community Hub in SouthEast Nigeria

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: Inefficient, costly transfers between Ethereum and Cardano limit interoperability, liquidity flow, and adoption across both ecosystems.
solution: A seamless, low-fee, open-source bridge enabling instant token transfer between Ethereum and Cardano, with fee-sharing to boost adoption and liquidity.
title: Ethereum to Cardano Multi-Asset Bridge Powered by Wormhole

problem: Ethiopian sellers and buyers lack a trusted, transparent, and secure online marketplace. Centralized platforms are costly, limited, and exclude many local merchants
solution: Build a decentralized e-commerce DApp with ADA and fiat/mobile money payments, smart contract escrow, and seller reputation tracking for Ethiopia..
title: EthioMarket DApp: Decentralized E-Commerce for Ethiopia

problem: University students in Ethiopia lack access to practical blockchain and Cardano knowledge. Without exposure, they miss opportunities to innovate, build, and connect with the global ecosystem.
solution: We're launching a Cardano Campus Tour across Ethiopian university to teach blockchain basics, showcase the Cardano ecosystem, and inspire students to join, innovate, and propose projects via Catalyst.
title: Ethiopia Cardano Campus Tour: Blockchain for Students

problem: Cardano adoption in ethiopia is minimal few businesses accept ADA citizens lack real world blockchain experience and small businesses see no practical use cases.
solution:
Accept ADA payments for café products.
Reward customers with NFT-based loyalty tokens.
Provide supply chain transparency for coffee beans.
Educate customers and SMEs on blockchain use cases.
title: Ethiopia's First ADA Cafe : Blockchain Adoption Pilot

problem: The Cardano ecosystem lacks support for the EUDI credential verification, hindering seamless KY, and privacy-preserving identity checks for regulated dApps in Europe.
solution: EUDI4Cardano employs zk-SNARK proofs from an off-chain, trustless endorser service to enable Cardano smart contracts to verify EUDI credentials, ensuring compliance and user privacy.
title: EUDI4Cardano – Interoperability of EUDI Wallets with Cardano

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: Cardano does not have a Euro regulated stablecoin limiting its usage and real life applications, particularly as a new regulatory framework (MiCa) comes into play.
solution: Launch a regulated and fiat backed EUR stablecoin on Cardano with a Tier 1 Asset Manager as Custodian of Asset. This is the first of many stablecoins for the 250M+ Lusophone market.
title: EUR Stablecoin on Cardano - Fiat Backed and MiCA Compliant

problem: With over 55 stars on GitHub the ebook: eUTxO Fundamentals is one of the most used resources for new developers coming to Cardano, however lacks plutarch and advanced chapters.
solution: This proposal will be executed together with Seungheon oh, a former Mlabs and current IOG developer, together we will add plutarch section and advanced techniques for smart contracts on cardano.
title: eUTxO Fundamentals: Plutarch and more [eBook] by elRaulito

problem: Understanding eUTXO programming can be hard for developers coming from other ecosystems, junior devlopers, kids exploring blockchain or non visual and kinetic learners.
solution: Gamifying the eUTXO learning experience by building a user friendly game that allows developers to learn eUTXO based programming while enjoying the process and getting rewarded in the process
title: eUTXO Quest

problem: Ethereum developers struggle to move their smart contracts to Cardano because the systems work very differently. There’s no simple way to translate the code, which slows down adoption.
solution: We’re building a simple toolkit that helps Ethereum developers convert their smart contracts into Cardano-compatible code. It translates familiar Solidity patterns into Aiken or Plutus. With examples
title: EVM-to-eUTXO Contract Translator Toolkit

problem: Kotlin based open-source historical and latest prices indexer for Cardano Native Tokens.
solution: A Kotlin based open-source historical and latest price indexer for Cardano Native Tokens. This will be Evolution 1, implementing performance improvements and expanding DEX trading data coverage.
title: Evolution 1 of Cardano Native Token Price Indexer in Kotlin

problem: Lovelace Academy has enormous potential for visibility, especially among young professionals, developers, and newcomers to Web3 but is not well known yet.
solution: We propose a structured Instagram content campaign designed to increase Lovelace Academy’s visibility, engagement, and audience growth.
title: Expanding Lovelace Academy’s Reach to More Devs on Instagram

problem: Employers can't trust local PDF certificates from Ethiopian developers. This widespread forgery blocks thousands of skilled professionals from accessing the global job market and fair wages.
solution: Our ExpertsWay app is launching an on-chain diploma system on Cardano. We will issue tamper-proof credentials to bridge the trust gap, unlocking global jobs for Ethiopian tech talent.
title: ExpertsWay: Cardano Credentials for Ethiopian Devs

problem: Social Media blockchain content is all hype & jargon. Without clear, simple education on real world applications and why Cardano matters, adoption risks going to louder, VC-funded, less capable chains
solution: We’ll produce simple, engaging Cardano explainers, amplified via influencers and ads, to cut jargon, grow awareness, and onboard new users through genuine understanding, not hype and price action.
title: Explaining Blockchain Simply: Cardano Education for Everyone

problem: In our ecosystem, new projects like Mithril, Amaru, Aiken, and Midnight are all built in Rust. Yet, the core library, pallas, has minimal capabilities compared to what the Haskell ecosystem offers.
solution: The addition of 3 modules to pallas: A plutus interpreter, a database operation module (cardano-db equivalent), and a network components module (peer manager, chain synchronizer, block fetcher, etc.).
title: Extend pallas - Adding to Cardano's core components in Rust

problem: Cardano DeFi data is opaque. Existing tools show cryptic hashes and values without explaining actions or outcomes to the average user.
solution: A DeFi that dashboard to showcase our semantic transaction intelligence approach to protocol operations from just on-chain footprint, turning cryptic transactions into clear insights and intents.
title: Exura: eUTxO Transaction & Portfolio Intelligence

problem: Users sign transactions without knowing exactly what will happen. This creates friction, risk, and fear of mistakes. No tool analyzes transactions and explain their effects *before* they are signed.
solution: Exura's API will analyze and describe your DeFi transactions even before you sign them. Clear language, open-source and wallet-ready. First integration: GameChanger wallet! ⚡
title: Exura Transaction Intelligence API + GameChanger Integration

problem: Current IoT systems are centralized, creating single points of failure and limiting secure, global access to data for international asset monitoring.
solution: A Cardano-based blockchain stores and retrieves IoT data securely across borders, removing central points of failure and enabling reliable global asset monitoring.
title: EyeOT: The IoT Supernetwork No One Can Shut Down

problem: Cardano has a lack of open source permissionless and decentralized solutions for fair token minting and mining.
solution: Open Source a fair, bot resistant mineable smart contract token application. This app includes the token miner application, a block explorer, the smart contract and associated offchain tooling.
title: Fair Mineable Smart Contract Tokens

problem: Online ticketing suffers from scalping, counterfeits, and chargeback abuse. Organizers lose revenue and trust. We’ll enforce fair sales and verifiable resale on Cardano with on-chain authenticity.
solution: Mint verifiable tickets on Cardano with resale caps and anti‑bot deposits. Enforce fair primary sales, controlled resales, and on‑chain authenticity with fast venue scans.
title: FairMint Tickets: Anti‑Scalping Ticketing on Cardano

problem: Small farmers and agribusinesses face limited tools to prove product origin, quality, and safety. Current supply chain tracking is fragmented and prone to fraud, reducing trust and market access.
solution: Develop a pilot agricultural traceability system using Cardano Foundation’s Originate to track products from farm to fork, ensuring transparency, quality verification, and increased market trust.
title: Farm-to-Fork Pilot with Cardano Foundation Originate

problem: Farm-to-table restaurants rely on trust and authenticity, but diners have no easy way to verify ingredient origins. Current provenance systems are fragmented, paper-based, and prone to greenwashing.
solution: Immutable Cardano registry linking menu items to verified farm, harvest date, and sustainability data via QR/NFC, enabling transparent ingredient traceability for restaurants and guests.
title: Farm-to-Table Ingredient Traceability on Cardano

problem: The FarmChain proposal is designed to solve the accessibility gap between blockchain-based agricultural finance tools (AgriFin) and African smallholder farmers.
solution: FarmChain will deliver localized Cardano education to African smallholder farmers via SMS and WhatsApp, requiring no internet or advanced devices.
title: FarmChain:SMS-Based Cardano Education for Smallholder Farmer

problem: Farmers lack capital to lease or expand farmland, while investors lack access to the high-yield returns generated from diverse agricultural produce cultivated by skilled farmers.
solution: NFTs represent farmland leases for agricultural produce. Smart contracts automate revenue distribution, splitting profits 50% to NFT holders and 50% reinvested for growth.
title: Farmland Lease Tokenization

problem: Public API is the main entry point for users and developers, shaping their experience with Cardano. Slow, unreliable, fragmented or pay-walled RPC and API means degraded user experience ecosystem-wide
solution: Lava offers unified, fast and reliable public API endpoints that make it easy for users to access Cardano. It connects users to the best APIs based on performance, giving users better uptime and UX
title: Fast and Reliable Public Access to Cardano APIs

problem: Cardano developers can’t do end-to-end testing in a browser like normal users during automated tests, since current wallets and test networks are not supported.
solution: We extend an existing Cardano Test Wallet with private network support that works in automated browser tests, letting developers test apps end-to-end just like real users.
title: Faster E2E DApp Testing with Private Network by Dquadrant

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem:
MAKING CARDANO NARRATIVE-READY FOR EVERY BUILDER
Cardano lacks a native, affordable, verifiable oracle-blocking DeFi, DEX, GameFi, AI, and builders from using real-world data safely, cheaply at scale.
solution: Orocle (mainnet-proven) : Cardano‑native oracle unlocking DeFi/DEX/GameFi/AI with secure feeds, VRF, and ZK/PCD verifiability, mainnet-proven, 50+ integrations, up to 98x cheaper,120+ enprises clients
title: Faster & Trusted Cardano Oracle, 98x Cheaper vs Chainlink

problem:
Cardano has very small number of projects which are not focused on money making (DeFi and similar).
We need more dapps for daily usage which aren't based on making/spending money.
solution: We'll build a wallet-authenticated feed reader as a starting point for exploring the web, building knowledge and social interactions.
title: Feed reader community platform

problem: Today’s collaborative writing tools lack transparent proof of contribution. This makes fair ownership, credit, and reward distribution nearly impossible, creating friction for creative teams.
solution: We will build FictionForge, a platform that uses Cardano to transparently track every contribution. This provides a foundation for provable ownership, fair credit, and automated rewards.
title: FictionForge: On-Chain Collaborative Writing Platform

problem: Open Source Risk Transfer Scripts Features: Multi-Asset, Oracle Triggered, KYC/AML Integration.
solution: We will extend our currently open source Smart Contracts to support USDM/Bitcoin,  integrate with Charlie3/Orcfax Oracles, and support KYC/AML/DID features.
title: Fida: Insurance Risk Transfer Contracts v-next

problem: Blockchain is booming in Vietnam, the Vietnamese community has a huge need to equip themselves with knowledge about Blockchain. There are not many courses about Blockchain in Vietnam.
solution: We plan to organize free Blockchain courses in Vietnam, focusing on basic knowledge education and practical applications.
title: [FIMI] Blockchain Course for Vietnamese

problem: Language barriers hinder the Vietnamese community's full understanding of English Cardano videos. Vietnamese voiceover videos are essential to deliver updates and news, boosting community growth.
solution: Vietnamese captions for Cardano videos, provided for free, help the Vietnamese community easily access knowledge and news, promoting participation in the ecosystem.
title: [FIMI] Bring Cardano Videos to Vietnamese

problem: Vietnamese Cardano community grows but needs a platform for deep knowledge exchange. An online forum is essential to discuss, share news, and increase participation, expanding the Cardano ecosystem.
solution: Organize Cardano Talk online and directly to provide, share knowledge, update technology and Cardano projects, promote participation and development of the Vietnamese community.
title: [FIMI] Cardano Talk for Vietnamese

problem: The Vietnamese Cardano community lacks channels to update news and knowledge quickly, accurately, and time-savingly, leading to difficulty accessing information about the rapidly developing ecosystem.
solution: Creating a Vietnamese Podcast channel about Cardano on Telegram helps the Vietnamese Cardano community access easily and quickly anytime, anywhere.
title: [FIMI] Podcast Cardano on Telegram for Vietnamese

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: Of 1.3B unbanked adults, 55% are women lacking financial access and economic opportunities. They face identity barriers, credit exclusion, and skill gaps that perpetuate poverty cycles.
solution: We provide unbanked women secure digital identity via Cardano DID, blockchain training for credit building, and STEM education through income-share agreements for employment.
title: Financial Inclusion for Unbanked Women via DID and Education

problem: Low financial education in females and people with disability in Africa. According to study by the Africa Development Bank, only about 20 % of women in Africa are financially literate.
solution: This project seek to provide education programs through workshops, to females and people with disability on financial literacy and resources available to them.
title: Financial Literacy and Cardano for Disabled and Women

problem: The Cardano ecosystem is highly innovative, but knowledge remains fragmented. Without a centralized library of verified on-chain data, searching and validating information is difficult.
solution: Spidex AI builds the first AI-native Cardano research library, with on-chain verification, data aggregation, indexing, storage, plus governance tools and APIs for fast, reliable access.
title: First Cardano Research Library with On-chain verification

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: Cardano users lack secure, first-class hardware wallet support; current devices offer only basic signing, leaving users exposed to blind signing risks. Signing exploits cost users $1.7B in 2024.
