solution: Enable Cardano on GridPlus devices with firmware, SDKs, wallet integration, docs, and support. Include feasibility research for smart-contract decoding; stretch for delivery.
title: First-Class Cardano Support for GridPlus Hardware

problem: Over 8M Tigrigna speakers lack Cardano education in their language. Most content is English/Amharic and internet heavy, excluding low bandwidth communities in Eritrea, Tigray, and the diaspora.
solution: Launch a Tigrigna first Cardano academy: short videos, mobile Telegram/WhatsApp groups, offline USB/SD kits for low bandwidth users, Q&As and a testnet challenge, with multilingual subtitles.
title: First Tigrigna Cardano Hub: Learn, Build, Connect Worldwide

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: There is currently no open source lending solution for multicollateral AMM lending pools and dynamic interest rates.
solution: Flow V2 is an open-source lending protocol that introduces multicollateral AMM lending pools and dynamic interest rates to Cardano.
title: Flow V2 - Open Source Multi Collateral AMM Lending Pools

problem: Many Cardano founders lack mentorship, resources, and networks, causing isolation, steep learning curves, and struggles with funding, marketing, and growth—slowing innovation.
solution: Launching the Founders Guild: bi-weekly expert workshops, vetted founder network, structured education, 1:1 advisory, and partnerships to help Cardano founders grow and collaborate.
title: Founders Guild: Cardano’s Founder Incubator

problem: Cardano lacks infrastructure for fractionalized telecom ownership, DAO-managed asset governance, or NFT-backed DeFi tools tied to real‑world hardware.
solution: We’ll prototype a Cardano-native staking, DAO treasury, and NFT-backed lending system powered by AirNode ownership, bridged via a dual-chain token model. Creating telecom-based on-chain governance.
title: Fractionalized Telocommunication Infrastructure On Cardano

problem: The lack of educational content about Cardano in French hinders the engagement of Francophone communities in the ecosystem.
solution: Create and publish video content and articles in French about Cardano to inform, educate, and engage the Francophone community.
title: Francophone Access to Cardano Through Education

problem: Cardano's decentralization is dropping. It's increasingly hard for new Stake Pool Operators to get established in Cardano, and a large risk and investment until maybe reaching profitability.
solution: Introducing a Free Tier to PoolMan.io which grants small SPOs (<250K ADA staked) a 6 month fully managed stake pool operation, and a chance to reach profitability and stand on their own going forward.
title: Free Tier for Small SPOs - Fully Managed SPO Service

problem: Major e-commerce platforms like Shopify, WooCommerce, and Wix lack native Cardano (ADA) support, creating barriers to online transactions and leaving a $10+ billion market untapped.
solution: Create a comprehensive, easy-to-install Cardano payment gateway enabling native ADA/token payments, direct wallet integration (Lace, Vespr, etc), and decentralized processing for e-commerce platforms.
title: FrenPay - Cardano Native Payment Gateway

problem: Cardano's adoption is hampered by technical impediments that can discourage traditional users. Devs waste time rebuilding the same complex social login bridges, slowing innovation and user adoption.
solution: An open-source backend for frictionless onboarding. It lets users log in with social accounts (Google, X, Discord, etc.) to instantly create a Cardano wallet. A plug-and-play tool for all developers.
title: Frictionless Onboarding: Open-Source Web2 Login to Wallet

problem: Developer onboarding to Cardano is hard due to scattered, outdated, and overly technical resources, limiting adoption and slowing dApp and ecosystem growth.
solution: We will create a two-part developer book series in English (Cardano 101 & 201) and 50+ companion videos, providing structured, open-source learning paths from basics to advanced dApp development.
title: From Beginner to Pro: Cardano Developer 101 & 201 Series

problem: Millions of Ethiopians lack access to financial literacy and safe investment tools, leaving them vulnerable to scams and inflation.
solution: Deliver workshops, guides, videos, and a fiat-to-ADA demo to teach Ethiopians financial literacy and safe blockchain investing on Cardano.
title: From Birr to Blockchain: Ethiopia’s Investor to Cardano

problem: AI assistants cannot make secure on-chain payments. Cardano lacks an AI wallet layer with spending rules and delegated authority, limiting AI's real-world transaction potential.
solution: One-time wallet setup with spending rules. AI agents receive session tokens to pay autonomously within limits. Works with Claude, and any MCP-enabled AI: instant small payments, approval for large.
title: From Chat to Checkout: Autonomous AI Payments via Cardano

problem: Cardano needs independent assessment of ₳ deployed across multiple funding programs (Catalyst, BuilderDAO). Requires expert framework for impact measurement & coordination for ₳350M annual treasury
solution: This engagement delivers assessment of Cardano's funding ecosystem. The project analyzes current funding mechanisms through documentation review, Fund 13/14 evaluation, and interviews.
title: Funding Assessment & Impact Framework

problem: Cardano seeks to expand credible, on-the-ground builder pipelines in Latin America that connect ecosystem teams to public-sector partners and impact use-cases.
solution: Run a Latin America residency with Cardano and other protocols to train builders, enrich knowledge, and connect teams with partners, expanding pipelines for real-world blockchain impact.
title: Funding the Commons Buenos Aires Residency

problem: Cardano lacks visibility in professional events in the broader web3 space to showcase progress, connect projects with partners, and ensure treasury-funded outcomes create clear value for Cardano.
solution: Run a RealFi conference in Buenos Aires to demo blockchain impact, showcase Catalyst Fund, drive new Catalyst applicants and connect Cardano with impact and cross-industry communities.
title: Funding the Commons: Driving RealFi + Catalyst Submissions

problem: Building on Cardano often requires deep knowledge and the skill. With Gamechanger we want to take a different approach. We want to make writing dApps the domain of every web developer out there.
solution: Gamachanger is made for rapid application developement. We are going to make it even better. Packing all our experience into a JS library that will make writing dApps easy for everyone
title: Gamechanger: Instant dApp, build for any device fast

problem: Current Cardano governance and dApps rely on centralized and external infrastructure for off-chain file, data and code storage, introducing single points of failure and limiting decentralization
solution: Rewrite and open-source GCFS as a TypeScript library for reading and searching files stored on-chain, and a web server that can even serve HTML for frontends, supporting fully on-chain resilient DApps
title: GameChanger: On-Chain File Storage on Cardano (GCFS)

problem: Existing Cardano multi-sig wallet tools like RoundTable and SummonDAO are either under-maintained or charge usage fees, creating accessibility and cost barriers.
solution: Develop an open-source Vue.js multi-sig wallet management tool for Cardano, enabling import and management of RoundTable and SummonDAO wallets, with affordable deployment.
title: Genesis: Open Source Multi-Sig Wallet

problem: Small clean energy producers lack transparent, affordable, decentralized tools to verify and monetize generation. Centralized solutions limit participation and slow energy transition
solution: Gengree uses Cardano to tokenize and verify clean energy generation, enabling transparent incentives and reducing barriers to entry for self generators and energy communities
title: Gengree: Blockchain Green Energy Tracker

problem: There is no reliable way to certify geospatial data on Cardano. Without secure, auditable, and standard-based solutions, adoption in logistics, real estate, and environmental use cases remains limited
solution: We will build an open-source API and Web3 platform for certifying and querying geospatial data on Cardano, ensuring authenticity, traceability, and interoperability with global GIS standards.
title: GeoSpace API

problem: Users must choose between privacy and regulatory compliance, revealing personal data in traditional KYC processes, which hinders blockchain adoption and contradicts the privacy values users cherish.
solution: zkFiat is a system using ZKP that enables users to comply with regulations without revealing personal data, preserving privacy and fostering blockchain adoption.
title: Gero - ZkFiat: The Future of Confidential Compliance

problem: Without accessible educational materials, Brazilian users face barriers to understanding technical aspects and participating in the community, hindering adoption.
solution: This project will establish a Substack blog and X account to deliver Original and AI-translated Cardano content in Portuguese (Brazilian).
title: Gerocardan: Blog Posts and X Content for Community Education

problem: The lack of Portuguese-language Cardano content limits Brazilian engagement with the ecosystem. Many technical and educational videos are available only in English.
solution: This project will create a YouTube channel, "Gerocardan," to upload AI-translated and subtitled Cardano videos in Portuguese (Brazilian).
title: Gerocardan: Video Translation for Community Education

problem: Traditional freelance platforms charge high fees, rely on centralized payment systems, and limit cross-border access. Cardano currently lacks a peer-to-peer ADA-based solution for gig payments.
solution: Create a proof-of-concept peer-to-peer freelance marketplace where users post jobs and pay in ADA, using smart-contract escrow to enable secure, low-cost cross-border gig transactions.
title: GigHub:Decentralized Freelance Marketplace with ADA Payments

problem: Students lack easy ways to earn money on campus, while blockchain adoption remains low in daily student life.
solution: GigsGig lets students post tasks, earn in ADA, and build campus micro-economies, driving real blockchain adoption.
title: GigsGig App: Building the Future of Campus Work with Cardano

problem: Cardano lacks clear guidance and resources to onboard university societies. Local builders struggle to form sustainable, student-led chapters, limiting community engagement and ecosystem growth.
solution: Publish a global open-source playbook with frameworks, mentorship, standards to help students and local builders form, run, and scale Cardano societies, guided by community insights and pilot tests.
title: Gimbalabs - Regional Cardano Student Society Playbook

problem: Many Cardano 101 resources exist, but none are designed for normal users. We lack a clear, region-agnostic onboarding guide showing what is “enough” to keep new users active in the ecosystem.
solution: We will design a beginner-friendly, multilingual onboarding playbook and workshops that guide individuals from basics to dApp usage, tested and refined with feedback across regions.
title: Gimbalabs ｜ VESPR - Cardano Onboarding Workshop Guideline

problem: The Cardano ecosystem seeks greater exposure to large corporations, but firms still lack blockchain understanding and fear vendor lock-in, a concern not unique to Cardano.
solution: Organize a series of ‘roadshow’ invitation-only events (five in total) to discuss corporate innovation needs, using the Cardano ecosystem as a lighthouse example.
title: GINI (German Industry Innovation) Event Series

problem: Charity organizations lack an easy way of raising capital for their projects and donors lack a transparent way to understand how, and if, their funds are being used correctly.
solution: Givinn lets charities raise funds with milestone-based releases through smart-contracts, ensuring donors are able to see exactly how their contributions are used through on-chain records.
title: Givinn: Blockchain-Powered Charity Platform

problem: Cardano has a strong online presence, but more in-person global events would help people connect, learn, and grow the community together.
solution: By hosting fun, educational global events, we create spaces where people can meet, share ideas, discover projects, level up together, and welcome more people into Cardano.
title: Global Cardano Community IRL Event for Education & Adoption

problem: The language barrier prevents much of the LATAM (Latin America) community from following Catalyst updates, reducing engagement and participation in the Global Townhalls.
solution: Produce videos and written reports summarizing the main news  shared at Global Townhall, in Portuguese and Spanish. The videos and reports will be made for every townhall from December to March.
title: Global Townhall Summaries for LATAM ⚡

problem: Waste recovery orgs lack digital tools for traceability and verification. Many lack formal records, so we provide templates and guidance to help them document impact and join circular markets.
solution: We will build an onboarding and verification system on Cardano, aligned with ISO 14001, 9001, and 45001, to help waste recovery orgs join and grow within a global sustainability network.
title: Global Waste Recovery: Verified Connection through Cardano

problem: No transparent, collaborative off-chain process exists for community consensus on Cardano’s text-based Constitution before on-chain voting.
solution: GovCircle facilitates collaborative off-chain consensus on Cardano’s Constitution via opinion discussion, version history, Event Management and impact tracking.
title: GovCircle: Strengthening Cardano’s Constitutional Framework

problem: Cardano governance lacks an efficient way to explore and compare dRep voting rationales, making informed participation time-consuming, fragmented, and inaccessible to most community members.
solution: We’ll build an AI assistant that extracts and clusters voting rationales, enabling questions, insight retrieval, and practical use of collective wisdom in Cardano governance.
title: Governance AI Assitant

problem: African communities lack access to Cardano governance training and developer skills, leading to low participation and underrepresentation in global blockchain decision-making.
solution: Host Cardano governance and developer workshops in 5 African countries, promoting DReps and smart contract basics to foster inclusive participation in the ecosystem.
title: Governance & Developer Workshops Across 5 African Countries

problem: The Cardano community struggles to understand on-chain governance and CIP-1694, partly due to the lack of a comprehensive and easily digestible source of information.
solution: As a DRep training leader, I created a presentation that participants found easy to understand. I want to rework & expand the materials, then make them available to everyone interested in governance.
title: Governance in Pictures

problem: Nation-states and emerging network-states lack a dedicated framework to engage with Cardano in pro-social, accountable, and verifiable ways.
solution: Research & develop a 'Government Kit' aligned with pro-social concepts and frameworks, providing reusable models for how Cardano can be integrated into traditional and emerging governance models.
title: Governance Kit R&D – Pro-Social Frameworks | CIP

problem: Current governance systems are costly, lacking transparency & accountability, leading to financial inefficiencies. Limited user interaction/engagement in gov processes hinder effective decision-making
solution: Revolutionizing Decentralized Governance with Transparency & Accountability. We offer interactive dashboards, proposal tracking, voting and treasury management with intuitive & accessible interface
title: GovernanceSpace - All-in-One Governance Platform Enhancement

problem: Rural Ethiopian youth lack access to education, digital skills, and blockchain opportunities.
solution: Build youth gardening competitions & workshops combining sustainability with Cardano literacy.
title: Green Future: Youth Gardening & Cardano Education

problem: Carbon credit markets lack transparency, trust, and accessibility due to centralized systems, limiting participation and efficiency in global carbon offset efforts.
solution: A Cardano-based DAO enables transparent, decentralized carbon credit trading and verification using NFTs, smart contracts, and governance to promote sustainability.
title: GreenDAO: Carbon Credit Platform on Cardano

problem: Hundreds of millions of tons of plastic enter the environment each year. Changing behavior is urgent but difficult, as many lack recognition, motivation, and incentives for sustainable action.
solution: Building a platform that recognizes and rewards green living and plastic reduction, powered by the Cardano blockchain to ensure transparency, fairness and scalability
title: GreenSnap: Rewarding Green Actions with Cardano Blockchain

problem: Universities and students hoard outdated files and backups, creating digital waste that drives up CO₂ emissions. GreenStore EDU tackles this by training and rewarding sustainable data practices.
solution: GreenStore EDU aims to train 4 Ghanaian universities to cut digital waste 20-30%, lowering CO₂ emitted from data centers. Cardano will be used to track while ADA rewards are given out as motivation.
title: GreenStore EDU: Sustainabe Digital Storage for Institutions

problem: Millions of students in rural Africa lack access to educational resources due to limited or unaffordable internet. This digital divide hinders their ability to learn and discover Cardano ecosystem.
solution: Provide curated Cardano Ecosystem educational content to millions of African communities through offline digital libraries servers.
title: Growing Cardano Ecosystem via Offline digital Library server

problem: Many Cardano projects struggle to effectively communicate their unique value, position themselves clearly, and engage optimal acquisition channels, limiting their market potential and adoption.
solution: We aim to support 3-5 Cardano projects with targeted GTM research and marketing insights to improve positioning, clarity, and translate technical innovation into compelling value propositions.
title: GTM Acceleration for Cardano Builders - STORM Partners

problem: Cardano lacks native, decentralized options trading tools, limiting DeFi users’ ability to hedge, speculate, and manage risk without centralized intermediaries.
solution: We enable decentralized options trading on Cardano by making each option a native token, freely tradable and secured by smart contracts
title: GY Options trading

problem: Halal certification today is largely paper-based and highly vulnerable to forgery, misrepresentation, and inconsistent oversight
solution: HalalCert++ is replacing paper-based, with a secure, blockchain-based verification system that integrates Atala PRISM (DIDs), computer vision AI compliance checks, and Midnight zero-knowledge proofs.
title: HalalCert++

problem: Children struggle to understand complex blockchain concepts, leading to a gap in knowledge about essential technologies like Cardano.
solution: Create catchy and educational songs about Cardano blockchain concepts to simplify learning, making it engaging and accessible for children, fostering their understanding of technology.
title: Harmonizing with Cardano: A Musical Exploration

problem: Agriculture in Japan remains disconnected from blockchain RWA markets, missing opportunities for transparent funding and global reach.
solution: An AI-powered RWA hub to showcase and verify agricultural opportunities in Japan, attracting global investors to Cardano’s ecosystem.
title: HashiRWA: Bridging Japan’s Agri RWA with AI

problem: Cardano projects often fail due to lack of funding, developers, and marketing support. No central hub exists to connect these resources. Project have to look through fragmented channels.
solution: An on-chain marketplace connecting Cardano projects with developers, marketers, and investors. Includes a reputation system, escrow smart contracts, and crowdfunding module.
title: HatchHub - The fundraising platform for Cardano Projects

problem: The core problem is the lack of Blockchain based accessible personalized healthcare solutions. It empowers individuals to proactively manage their health through AI-driven insights & blockchain data.
solution: HealthPilot, in collaboration with Microsoft, pioneers AI-driven healthcare platforms app with blockchain integration, it securely stores user health data, enabling proactive health empowerment.
title: HealthPilot: Navigat a New Era in Healthcare with AI & B.C

problem: Women lack awareness of blockchain and Cardano, missing chances in innovation, startups, and financial inclusion, leaving them and their communities behind, with Ethiopia highlighting the gap.
solution: HERADA empowers women to use “her ADA” to learn blockchain, launch startups, earn income, innovate, and build a brighter future for herself and her community.
title: HERADA: Cardano-Powered Incubator for Women-Led Startups

problem: AI and physics simulations on decentralized nodes typically ship huge Docker images. Pulling/unpacking these 3–11+ GB images dominates time‑to‑first‑compute, causing long cold‑starts, bandwidth waste.
solution: Compile models and simulations ahead-of-time into lightweight, self-contained executables that run without PyTorch or any heavy frameworks. No gigabyte containers, nodes download MB-scale artifacts.
title: Hetzerk: Framework‑Free, Precompiled Training & Simulation

problem: We aim to solve the lack of deep, trusted understanding of Cardano among high-value investors by offering private, tailored onboarding that builds trust, removes barriers, and drives adoption.
solution: Conduct 100+ private, high-trust meetings to educate investors, business owners & set up wallets, gift ADA, and provide ongoing support via an exclusive group to drive adoption and capital inflow.
title: High-Impact Investor Onboarding: Exclusive Cardano Growth

problem: Cardano DEX data is fragmented. Heavy TS/REST indexers hurt speed and portability. We need a Rust + gRPC, light-node indexer to unify swaps/LP events for L1, sidechains, and forks.
solution: Rust-based Cardano DEX indexer with gRPC and light-node support. Canonicalizes swaps/LP events, fast sync, reorg-safe, and portable for L1, sidechains, and forks.
title: High-Performance Cardano DEX Indexer — Rust + gRPC

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: U.S. homeowners are asset-rich but cash-poor, struggling to unlock home value without debt, while global investors seek safe, asset-backed alternatives to volatile crypto.
solution: HausCoin tokenizes U.S. home equity on Cardano, providing homeowners with debt-free liquidity and investors with stable, appreciating real estate-backed assets, thereby creating a new asset class.
title: High-Yield RWA on Cardano: Tokenized U.S. Real Estate

problem: The lack of verifiable carbon credit systems in Paraguay's prevents landowners from monetizing sustainable practices, limiting their participation in carbon markets and environmental efforts.
solution: A platform will issue Verra-compliant carbon credits under Paraguay Law 7190/2023 through NMKR, using IoT sensors and Wolfram Alpha to verify carbon sequestration via Aiken smart contracts on Cardano
title: High Yield Tokenized Carbon Credits

problem: connecting UTxO RPC and buildooor transaction builder
solution: We would like to implement a module to allow UTxO RPC to be used as provider for buildooor
title: HLabs: Buildooor <> UTxO RPC

problem: current cddl tooling are close to non exsitent, there should be something to to better use of cddl than letting human interpret it.
solution: We propose to realize a command line tool to help developer better understand the cddl they are looking at, generating examples and test cases.
title: HLabs: cddl-tools

problem:
Devs often build without consulting users - especially marginalised users - early enough, so their products lack real-world impact. 
People want to help, but rarely ask homeless people what they need.
solution:
Co-production!
Devs meet homeless people and co-create ideas. Devs then propose dApps to address a need for homeless people; we’ll run a vote at homeless organisations, and give a prize to the winner.
title: Homeless Hub Ideas Lab - ideating dApps for homeless people

problem: in Ethiopia Investors and companies do not know how to invest and work on the Cardano blockchain.  There is a big problem because there is no bridge for companies and developers to work together.
solution: Hope Bridge,We will launch a networking website, connects Ethiopian companies and investors to Cardano developers. helping developers work with companies to create blockchain-based solutions.
title: Hope Bridge: Connecting Ethiopian Investors to Cardano

problem: Brazil's Cardano community lacks frequent in-person events and Portuguese content, limiting trust, engagement, and collaboration opportunities.
solution: We will host monthly dinners with Town Halls, X Spaces, coworking sessions, and develop a community website to boost trust, engagement, and collaboration in Brazil's Cardano community.
title: Hub Cardano in Brazil Operations - By GovChainLab

problem: No adoption without real-world dApps and daily usability.
solution: Leverage Hydra to launch a user-friendly auction platform for state assets — driving engagement, transactions, and real-world adoption.
title: Hydra Auctions: Driving Real-World ADA Utility

problem: Roaming settlements are slow, costly, and rely on clearinghouses, raising prices for customers.  A perfect real-world B2B usecase for Hydra - a faster, cheaper, and more transparent alternative.
solution: We will build a solution for real-time roaming settlement using Cardano’s Hydra Layer-2 (with L1 finality ). This can replace costly roaming clearing houses and drive enterprise adoption of Cardano.
title: Hydra-Based Roaming Settlement System for Teleco Operators

problem: AI inference is opaque, centralized and unverifiable. Cardano lacks a secure, high-speed framework that will allow users to verify outputs, trace reasoning, and audit data sources in real time.
solution: Hydra-enabled on-chain GPT framework that securely logs prompts, token usage, reasoning and data sources on Cardano introducing verifiable AI with increased transparency and trustlessness.
title: Hydra-Enabled On-Chain ChatGPT for Secure & High-Speed AI

problem: Cardano lacks a no-code, enterprise-grade framework to automate, integrate, and onboard institutional operations efficiently, hindering adoption by businesses needing scalable, low-friction solutions.
solution: A no-code/low-code SDK to integrate complex enterprise systems like ERPs into Cardano, enabling secure, scalable onboarding and automation without requiring deep blockchain expertise.
title: Hydra Enterprise OS: Onboarding Institutions with Low-code

problem: Hydra Hexcore solves infrastructure deployment challenges for Hydra by providing automation beyond Docker image & Hydra TUI, avoiding manual setup and custom tooling that slow devs down.
solution: Hydra Hexcore simplifies Hydra node deployment & management with full automation, saving time, optimizing infrastructure, and supporting scalable Hydra-based apps
title: Hydra Hexcore – Tool for Deployment Multi-Hydra Party

problem: Developers struggle with complex setup and lack of affordable Hydra nodes for testing, limiting dApp development and reducing the appeal of Hydra and the Cardano ecosystem
solution: Build the Hydra Hub solution — a shared, low-cost, scalable infrastructure platform with ready-to-use Hydra nodes, simplifying setup and enabling developers to easily test and deploy dApps with Hydra
title: Hydra Hub – SaaS Node Distribution System Phase 1

problem: This proposal introduces a tech demo using a popular game Minecraft to showcase server synchronization through Hydra L2, aiming to increase awareness for the Cardano's scaling technology.
solution: Doom on Hydra was a viral showcase of its speed and capabilities. This proposal introduces "Minecraft on Hydra", letting players on different servers stream world changes and play together seamlessly.
title: Hydra Minecraft

problem: Mobile devs lack a native, well-documented SDK to open/join Hydra Heads and build/sign/broadcast transactions from Android/iOS. This blocks real-time, low-fee mobile dApps on Cardano
solution: Open-source Flutter SDK wrapping hydra-node WebSocket/HTTP, tx building via CSL/CML or Dart libs and sample apps for Hydra Integration into Mobile Apps
title: Hydra Mobile SDK for Android & iOS

problem: Cardano lacks an open-source, non-custodial merchant PoS and invoicing system that supports ADA/CNTs, avoids fees/KYC, and offers fast settlement via Hydra for real-world commerce.
solution: An open-source, PoS and invoicing toolkit for ADA/CNTs, non-custodial, fee-free, Hydra-enabled, with APIs, QR payments, and retail-friendly UI for global Cardano adoption in real world commerce.
title: Hydra-Point-of-Sale: Accept ADA, CNTs in Retail & Invoicing

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: The EV industry struggles with fragmented and opaque battery traceability. Without trusted, verifiable systems, the supply chain faces compliance gaps and risk losing control over sensitive data.
solution: LW3 uses Cardano Hydra to provide scalable, low-cost, and secure EV battery traceability with verifiable tokens, ensuring fast, private, and transparent compliance across the supply chain.
title: Hydra-Powered EV Battery DPP: Privacy + Transparency

problem: Cardano lacks engaging, hands-on showcases at major conferences, limiting awareness of Hydra and reducing visibility compared to competing ecosystems.
solution: We will create premium Hydra-powered gamified badges that act as both souvenirs and demo units, showcasing Cardano through interactive, hands-on conference experiences.
title: Hydra Powered Gamified Badges for Blockchain Conferences

problem: GameFi on Cardano is underdeveloped due to speed and fee limitations; Hydra, though new, needs real-world projects to prove its effective application in GameFi.
solution: Build the M-SCI RPG Shooter with Hydra, delivering a fast, cost-effective, fair Web3 gaming experience like Web2, ensuring transparency to engage players and boost GameFi on Cardano.
title: Hydra-Powered M-SCI RPG Shooter: Next-Gen GameFi on Cardano

problem: Hydra’s complex setup and Haskell/DevOps demands force 80% of projects to drop layer-2 (2024 poll), blocking startups from scaling gaming and microtransactions, and slowing Cardano’s real adoption.
