problem: Cardano stablecoins (USDA, USDM) and RWA tokens face shallow, fragmented liquidity—causing slippage, impermanent loss, and unstable yields—limiting adoption and trusted market access.
solution: NODO brings AI-powered vaults to Cardano, delivering deep USDA, USDM, and RWA liquidity with minimized impermanent loss, higher yields, and scalable adoption across the ecosystem.
title: NODO: Cardano’s AI Liquidity Layer for USDA, USDM & RWAs

problem: Cardano DeFi traders face a dilemma: AI-powered trading requires surrendering private keys to custodial systems ; manual trading misses profitable opportunities across traditional and crypto markets.
solution: Self-hosted AI trading bot combining market intelligence with Cardano DeFi analysis. Users maintain full custody while AI runs locally in a sandbox, bridging TradFi insights with crypto execution.
title: Non-Custodial AI Trading Bot on Cardano

problem: Cardano needs more digital and IRL events that feel less like traditional blockchain or DeFi gatherings and more like engaging, memorable experiences.
solution: Music Video Fest is an annual Cardano event that acts as a fantastic marketing tool, engaging a dynamic audience and showcasing Cardano’s strengths.
title: Nucast: Music Video Festival 2026

problem: Cardano features self-sovereign identity and Verifiable Credential technologies, but lacks support for trust propagation and anchoring at the machine-to-machine layer, a key need for DePIN networks.
solution: NuNet will develop an integration layer between DePIN orchestration with NuNet’s NuActor system and Cardano SSI/Verifiable Credentials technologies, ie. Hyperledger Identus or other.
title: NuNet: Cardano supported SSI/DID for DePIN Orchestration

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: How to boost Cardano's decentralization and resilience? NuNet’s decentralized compute layer, proven with SPO deployments, needs broader adoption and stronger operational tooling and security.
solution: Develop and expand Cardano SPO infrastructure via NuNet’s decentralized deployment and compute orchestration platform facilitated by NuNet Appliance in partnerships SPOs and reliable compute providers
title: NuNet: Decentralized SPO Computing - Scaling&Expansion

problem: Inability to use multiple GPUs of multiple computers across NuNet’s network hinders many decentralised compute applications, including large scale AI model training, federated learning and others.
solution: Enabling the NuNet platform to support GPU clustering from multiple compute providers in a decentralized network for large scale distributed jobs, potentially approaching scale of big cloud providers
title: NuNet: Enabling GPU clusters - Scaling&Expansion

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: Blockchain industry and Cardano decentralises payment infrastructure on software and logical levels, but is still exposed to single points of failure due to reliance on centralized compute providers.
solution: A framework for deployment and management of Hydra Heads via NuNet protocol, for a fully decentralised multi-party, collaborative and transparent payment networks implementation in Cardano ecosystem.
title: NuNet: Hydra-Powered Micropayments for DePIN

problem: Existing solutions are not designed for deployment of AI agents on decentralised and distributed edge infrastructure. EdgeAI needs decentralised alternative for secure deployment and payments
solution: A secure framework for AI agents on DePINs, using decentralized identity and authentication, on-chain payments and off-chain contract workflow based on zero trust model and object capability paradigm.
title: NuNet: Secure framework for Edge AI with on-chain payments

problem:
TCG games are mostly unexplored market in the Cardano ecosystem.
Hearthstone at it's peak, as reported by Blizzard, had 100 million registered players and more than 23.5 million active players.
solution: A deep-sea world, careful balancing and ground-up redesign offer a highly competitive experience expanded upon with player guilds, a cooperative boss raid system tied to an explorable world map.
title: OctoWars - a TCG game

problem: Current web3 wallet implementations ignore 2.6 billion offline people—mostly in rural or underserved areas-—and 600 million feature phone users perpetuating global economic inequality.
solution: An open-source offline wallet and partner platform enabling secure SMS-based transactions, powering NGOs, partners, and gov’t to deliver transparent aid to recipients without internet or smartphones.
title: Offline Community Wallet & Partner Management Portal

problem: NET developers lack SDK support for Ogmios ledger queries and transaction submission, limiting adoption and forcing fragmented, time-consuming manual integrations and maintenance.
solution: Extend OgmiosDotnet with full ledger query and transaction submission support, bringing .NET to feature parity with Ogmios and simplifying Cardano blockchain integration for developers.
title: OgmiosDotnet: Blockchain Queries & Transaction Submission

problem: Developers need a simple way to filter Cardano blocks and get only needed transactions via HTTP or gRPC, removing Ogmios SDK barriers, with a scalable queue and reliable, retriable delivery.
solution: Filter Cardano blocks and publish only needed transactions via HTTP or gRPC, enabling any language to consume them via a scalable queue, with an example consumer showing real-time transaction visuals.
title: OgmiosDotnet: Cardano Blockchain Events & Visualisation

problem: Education certificates vulnerable to forgery and manipulation, limiting impact for university/employment applications in an AI-enhanced world.
solution: Exponential Partners + MTech create blockchain POC: on-chain competency certificates using UVerify.io, minting tamper-proof STEM credentials on Cardano.
title: On-Chain Certificates for Training and Education Programmes

problem: Chemistry powers a $5T industry, yet data sits in centralized, outdated formats (e.g., SMILES). Opaque synthesis slows verification, innovation and access for researchers and industry worldwide.
solution: Build a Cardano proto-infrastructure for on-chain verifiable chemistry: a type-safe Haskell molecule model, Plutus validators for (retro)synthesis steps, and a public ledger others can reuse.
title: On-chain Verifiable Chemistry

problem: In Ethiopia, ADA adoption is limited. almost no merchants accept it, and most people have no way to spend it locally, keeping Cardano from becoming a practical, everyday currency.
solution: Onboard 30 Ethiopian merchants to accept ADA through wallet setup, training, signage, a public merchant map, and promotion, making Cardano usable in daily transactions.
title: onboard 30 ethiopian merchants to accept Cardano(ADA)

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: Cocoa, coffee, and palm oil farmers in Nigeria’s Cross River lack EUDR trace readiness; without blockchain-powered compliance, they risk losing market access, threatening incomes and local economies.
solution: Partner with Boki LGA, State of Cross River, and Pond Foundation to onboard up to 50,000 Nigerian farmers onto Cardano with ESG-compliant on-chain traceability and millions of trace events annually.
title: Onboard 50,000 Nigerian Farmers for Compliant Traceability

problem: Dubai's large community of expat coders is an untapped resource for Cardano. Without targeted training and support, their potential to build on the ecosystem is lost.
solution: We will provide targeted onboarding for Dubai's expat developers through coding workshops and creating a local support network to help them start building on Cardano.
title: Onboarding Dubai's Expat Coders to Cardano

problem: In the Philippines, a 115M-strong crypto market, Cardano has a limited presence, while other chains capture the growth. Without localized education, users stay unaware, and developers build elsewhere.
solution: Bitskwela will drive Cardano’s growth in the Philippines through a five-month campaign combining localized education, grassroots activations, media visibility, and developer onboarding.
title: Onboarding Filipinos to Cardano: Education & Activation

problem: University students in Brazil lack awareness of blockchain,  Web3 opportunities, and Cardano limiting new talent in the ecosystem.
solution: A 1-year program with lectures at 12 educational institutions in 3 cities to teach blockchain, with a workshop on cardano wallet creation and informations about how to join the Cardano Community
title: Onboarding of college students in Brazil

problem: The learning curve for Web2 developers & businesses cause delays in adoption and ecosystem growth.
solution: A modular template application with common Web3 capabilities, to accelerate Web2 developer adoption of decentralised solutions on Cardano.
title: Onboarding to Web3: Modular Applications for Web2 Builders

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: Cardano lacks a unified, standardized analytics platform. Fragmented data sources conceal ecosystem activity and limit comparability, hindering institutional adoption and investor insight.
solution: We turn Cardano’s raw blockchain data into clear, standardized metrics—covering the full ecosystem—and distribute them through dashboards, APIs, and partners to reach millions of users worldwide.
title: Onchain analytics for the Cardano ecosystem

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: Cardano lacks a native, transparent multi-pair leverage trading protocol with seamless DEX market orders, limiting efficient on-chain long and short strategies.
solution: We will build a Cardano leverage trading protocol supporting multiple pairs, executing market orders via Splash in one transaction for full transparency and efficiency.
title: Onchain Leverage Trading on Splash

problem: Cardano lacks tools to classify deployed Plutus smart contracts by type or usage This makes it hard for developers, auditors,researchers to understand ecosystem dynamics or discover relevant contracts
solution: We’ll build an ML-powered library that classifies on-chain Plutus contracts by category (DeFi, NFTs, etc.), providing CLI tools, APIs, and datasets to support developers and researchers.
title: On‑Chain Smart Contract Classifier Library (Python/JS) 📚

problem: Most collaboration tools are off-chain, hiding verifiable proof of work, while on-chain ools are too technical and lack proven, DAO-friendly collaboration models.
solution: A blockchain-powered collaboration tool based on proven decentralized practices, that record tasks and contributor activity, enabling verifiable proof of work.
title: On‑Chain Task and Contributor Verification

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: Lack of a Retail focussed Insurance Solution in web3; let alone a micro insurance for any transaction on Cardano chain and DApps.
solution: Insurance-On-The-Go for any transaction being done on blockchain; completely retail focussed; no annual Insurance premiums; Pay-as-you-Go; and cover against any possible web3 hack or exploit.
title: One-Click Insurance for transactions onCardano Chain & DApps

problem: Deploying and interacting with smart contracts on Midnight requires deep blockchain expertise, restricting participation to experienced developers and limiting ecosystem growth.
solution: We will build a web platform with a graphical interface for deploying smart contracts, and prefabricated SDKs with APIs, workflows and UI components for seamless interaction and integration.
title: One-Click Midnight: Smart Contract Deployment Platform

problem: Token launches on Cardano lock projects to a single DEX, creating isolated markets, arbitrage inefficiency, and limiting flexibility, competition, and visibility.
solution: Upgrade and open-source audited, permissionless launchpad to deploy liquidity across multiple DEXes in one flow, boosting flexibility while staying decentralized and ecosystem-aligned.
title: One Launchpad for All DEXes: Deploy Tokens on Cardano

problem: Using external assets such as Bitcoin/USDC in Cardano DeFi requires users to take multiple steps over a period of time. This inhibits onboarding new users and liquidity into Cardano's DeFi ecosystem.
solution: A new type of bridge that lets users bridge, swap, lend, or borrow BTC or USDC (or any asset) in Cardano DeFi dapps with one transfer on the native chain directly from centralized exchange accounts
title: One Shot Cross-Chain DeFi Research: Testnet MVP

problem: Cardano is a powerful technology that’s often misunderstood in the crypto space. It’s vital to educate more people so they can share this knowledge and help raise awareness across the industry.
solution: I plan to host online training on Cardano’s key features: UTxO model, Nakamoto consensus, liquid staking, decentralization, and more—to help others understand and engage with its full potential.
title: Online Cardano Training

problem: Open DJED offers a more reliable & accessible front-end to DJED. Costs associated with its maintenance, development, and infra render its operation unsustainable without funding, risking obsolescence.
solution: To ensure Open DJED’s long-term survival as a key public good, this proposal funds vital maintenance, protocol updates, and new features to serve the Cardano community.
title: Open DJED maintenance, development and infrastructure

problem: The cognitive load of structuring, aligning, and budgeting proposals deters many talented developers from applying for funding
solution: Collaborative, AI-enabled open source proposal tool with reusable context, version control, and direct integration to Cardano Project Catalyst
title: Open Proposal Platform for Decentralised Organisations

problem: Crypto founders ask "Is this compliant?" but can't navigate complex regulations. As crypto becomes mainstream, Cardano projects need instant regulatory clarity to build confidently
solution: Open MCP server giving developers real-time US & UK crypto compliance intelligence. Query regulations, integrate into workflows. Build compliant, ship faster, leverage the crypto-friendly shift.
title: Open Regulation MCP Server for Cardano

problem: Developers lack open-source batcher implementations for orderbook DEXs/AMM DEXs, limiting their ability to interact with orders, tap into liquidity, and build on top of platforms like MuesliSwap.
solution: We will provide open-source batcher implementations for our orderbook contract, enabling developers to interact with orders, access liquidity, and integrate advanced features like TxChaining.
title: Open-Source Batchers for Orderbook DEXs

problem: Blockchain have a bad reputation in the gaming community. An educational game focused on reforestation could be a good vehicle to attract more people to Cardano and shows it as a blockchain for good.
solution: Make an educational reforestation game to attract new users from outside the blockchain to Cardano and to showcase a successful story of web3 indie game development combining Cardano and Godot.
title: Open Source Educational Reforestation Game

problem: There is a lack of production-ready, open-source smart contracts on Cardano for complex RealFi workflows. Most developers must start from scratch, slowing down innovation and adoption.
solution: We propose open-sourcing Reafino SmartStarter’s production-ready smart contracts with docs, giving Cardano developers ready-to-use, field-tested RealFi primitives for crowdfunding and pooled capital.
title: Open Sourcing Reafino SmartStarter Smart Contracts

problem: Small Cardano projects face high CEX market-making costs and fragmented integrations, leading to poor liquidity, wide spreads, and slow, costly exchange onboarding.
solution: An open-source SDK enabling Cardano projects to run professional market-making across multiple CEXs with CNT support, advanced strategies, and zero monthly fees.
title: OpenMM: Cardano’s Universal Market Making Toolkit

problem: Open public spaces lack safe, reliable power. Students/visitors can’t study or charge devices. PV exists but lacks per-site visibility and tamper-evident reporting to justify expansion.
solution: Install 5 islandable PV+battery “Power Pods” in UGM Faculty of Engineering mini-parks (PoC). Sign telemetry and anchor daily Merkle-root proof on Cardano. Open-source the full kit for replication.
title: OpenVolts: Cardano-Anchored Energy Pods for Public Spaces

problem: JetBrains IDE users cannot develop Opshin smart contracts efficiently. While VS Code has an Opshin extension, JetBrains users has no Opshin support.
solution: I will build an open-source JetBrains plugin providing syntax highlighting, real-time error checking via Opshin compiler integration, and one-click contract compilation.
title: Opshin Jetbrains Extension

problem: The existing Opshin playground is broken. Without a functional Opshin playground, developers face high barriers to entry, undermining Opshin's goal of making Cardano accessible.
solution: I will create the Opshin Playground as a web IDE with Monaco editor for Python code editing, backend compilation service for instant Plutus Core generation, validator testing with sample inputs.
title: Opshin Playground - Online IDE for Opshin

problem: Opshin devs must constantly switch between VSCode and terminal for building, and testing. The lack of integrated tooling forces manual and disrupts development flow, slowing down Opshin development.
solution: I will create a VSCode extension that integrates Opshin and its tools directly into the editor. Developers will compile, build artifacts, and test contracts with one click
title: Opshin VSCode Extension

problem: Traditional hiring is inefficient, opaque, and trustless, especially in freelance and global gig markets. There is no standard for verifying skills, reputation, or reliability across borders.
solution: OPUS is a Web3 hiring platform using smart contracts and trust scores to verify work history, reputation, and availability. It eliminates middlemen and brings transparency to global hiring.
title: OPUS: Trust-Based Hiring for the Future of Work

problem: Interest Rate Derivatives, the largest global market with trillions in daily volume, lack on-chain data via Cardano Oracles, limiting TradFi and Cardano DeFi development
solution: Source USD Interest Rate data from 3 interest rate brokers and post on-chain for Cardano apps, in collaboration with a leading Oracle provider we’re in talks with on implementation details.
title: Oracle for Interest Rate Derivatives

problem: Orcfax does not provide latest price UTxO for direct use and instead leaves this to integrators to discern. However, the need for time-sensitive data is a requirement of many DeFi protocols.
solution: Develop an open-source Cardano smart contract that collects Orcfax Fact Statements and publishes the latest validated price data, enabling easy, secure DeFi integration.
title: Orcfax Live Feed Extension – Latest Price Smart Contract

problem: Centralised Web2 platforms profit from exploiting user data, eroding autonomy, and harming mental health through surveillance, misinformation, opaque algorithms, and vulnerable data silos.
solution: Modular Cardano protocol with NFT-gated vaults on IPFS/Arweave. Segmented data access, consent-based sharing, and user rewards for monetising information via Web3 wallets.
title: Organic Networks - Privacy-First Data Vault & Dao Governance

problem: 質の高いイベントを企画するだけでなく、イベントを複数回開催することで、常に多くの関心を集めることができます。
solution: Cardanoの関係者を招くイベントを日本全国で行い、話題性や新規性、そして技術の発展を感じてもらえる機会を増やしていきます。それらはインフルエンサーを活用することでより大きな訴求効果をもたらすことができます。
title: Organising events that keep Cardano in the news in Japan 2

problem: Fake drugs threaten health and cost millions in Ecuador. Poor traceability allows counterfeits to enter supply chains, endangering lives, especially for rare diseases.
solution: We will build an open-source system with Cardano Foundation's Originate to trace medications, ensuring authenticity and safety in Ecuador's supply chain
title: Originate MedTrace

problem: Off-chain code for DApps may fail to persist enough state to recover funds, which can be critical if using e.g. Hydra, especially as manual persistence is error-prone and can be open to attacks.
solution: Our orthogonally persistent engine for off-chain code will persist data over multiple datacenters, such that DApps using it can never lose funds due to failure to persist.
title: Orthogonal Persistence for DApps on Cardano by Sky Protocol

problem: Leios softens determinism and fee predictability. DReps must choose the right path, which requires understanding Leios—a key benefit for developers, the community, and informed governance decisions.
solution: As a leading educator in the community, I plan to organize online courses focused on Ouroboros Leios. These will primarily educate DReps, while also welcoming other interested community members.
title: Ouroboros Leios Online Training

problem: Real estate is inaccessible to most due to high entry costs, complexity, and lack of transparency - especially for crypto-native and small retail investors.
solution: We are building OWN, a platform that lets anyone invest in real estate from €100 using blockchain - simple, secure, and accessible passive income.
title: OWN: Earn Passive Income from Tokenized Real Estate

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: Africa’s road transport lacks transparency, secure payments, and reliable records. This limits trust, traceability, and efficiency in managing intercity public transit systems.
solution: We’re integrating Cardano’s blockchain and ADA wallet into OYA BusRide to power a secure travel card system for Africa’s road transport, enhancing trust, traceability, and safety.
title: OYA BusRide: ADA Transit Tickets, Manifest & Welfare System

problem: Game developers on Cardano lack an easy-to-use framework for P2E ADA rewards. This high technical barrier slows the creation of new games on the platform and limits ecosystem growth.
solution: We will build an open-source P2E framework to make adding ADA rewards simple & cheap for devs. We will demonstrate it with a fun puzzle game, providing a ready-to-use model for the community.
title: P2E ADA: Open-Source Framework for Game Devs

problem: Cardano lacks user-friendly DAO platforms with automated on-chain execution. Existing solutions like Summon shut down or use off-chain voting without true governance automation.
solution: We build the first complete DAO platform for Cardano with automated on-chain execution. Votes directly trigger treasury spending and DeFi operations on-chain.
title: Paideia DAO Management: the path to MVP on mainnet

problem: Fashion lacks transparency and overproduces, while small artists can’t reach global markets. We use Cardano NFTs as digital passports to verify origin, materials, and creators, reducing waste.
solution: Patilla Noir uses small-batch fashion with non-transferable Cardano NFT digital passports, detailing garment origin, materials, and artists, to support creators, cut waste, and build trust.
title: Patilla Noir: Artistic and Digital Product Passports

problem: 3 problems need to be solved. 1) Legal cannabis globally lacks stable payment systems. 2) Supplychain logistics or Seed to Sale are not trustworthy. 3) Genetics & Lab results are not verifiable.
solution: The Lion City cannabis based NFT team will pilot a Cardano on-chain payment system, QR code for supply chain logistics, lab results, genetics and Age checks utilizing DiD protocol.
title: Pay & Verify: Cardano for Legal Cannabis Payments!

problem: Global payment barriers block businesses and individuals: 60+ countries restricted from major processors, 7-30 day delays, 3-8% fees, banking requirements, and fraudulent chargebacks.
solution: PayShare enables instant global payments via Cardano links. Create URL, share anywhere, receive ADA immediately with transparent ~$0.10 fees. No banks, delays, or restrictions.
title: PayShare: share links, receive payments

problem: Misinformation spreads fast in local languages, causing fear and conflict. There’s no real-time, multilingual tool to detect and verify false content at scale.
solution: PeaceGuard AI is a mobile and web app that detects, verifies, and proactively alerts users about false content in real time, supporting local languages and low-bandwidth use.
title: PEACEGUARD AI - A MULTILINGUAL MISINFORMATION DETECTION & VE

problem: In Cardano's Ouroboros BFT PoS consensus, validators have no incentives to store historical data as archival nodes, risking centralization, gated access, and loss.
solution: KYVE is a permissionless protocol that verifies data integrity from sources to store it on decentralized storage like Arweave. Data are then accesible as a public good.
title: Permanent trustless public good archive of Cardano data

problem: Cardano lacks a liquid composable settlement layer that's fully interoperable with all dApps and DEXs, which prevents users from accessing efficient market making strategies and larger settlements.
solution: Wizard aims to establish a standardized, global, non-custodial liquidity layer that is fully composable with all DEXs and liquidity pools (smart contracts), creating a unified main settlement layer.
title: Permissionless Global P2P & Grid trading

problem: Counterfeit medicines and opaque supply chains threaten public health, erode trust, undermine regulation, and inflict heavy economic losses on patients, payers, and the pharmaceutical industry.
solution: PharmaDNA is a blockchain and IoT platform that issues a digital passport for each drug batch, ensuring supply chain transparency, preventing counterfeiting, and safeguarding public health.
title: PharmaDNA: Drug traceability powered by Blockchain & AIoT

problem: Cardano's development landscape lacks a lightweight, open-source explorer offering customizable on-chain data visualizations. This forces developers to create bespoke tools, forcing repeated effort.
solution: The discontinued Cardano Foundation explorer will be revived to become a lightweight, open-source tool. Its backend will be replaced with community APIs to enable custom on-chain data visualizations.
title: Phoenix Explorer: Reviving an Open-source Explorer

problem: EU phytosanitary plant passports are outdated, mostly manual and heavily paper-based that causes inefficiency, fraud risk and low transparency across the supply chain./ The US has a even bigger market
solution: By implementing identity system for plants across the NL/EU/US we offer a Cardano blockchain based solution using NFT for traceability, compliance and transparency.
title: Plant Passport 3.0

problem: Cardano is a great fit to provide a trusted settlement layer for online strategy boardgames, yet there does not exist any such solution on Cardano, even for such a widely played game as Chess.
solution: Our solution will provide an open extensible platform, allowing players to play Chess first, then other boardgames, online in a cheap and trusted way, using Layer 2 for game play.
title: Playing Chess on Hydra

problem: Mangrove restoration lacks accessible, verifiable proof, limiting funding, partnerships, and scale. Existing blockchain solutions are closed, non-replicable, and unsuitable for smaller NGOs.
solution: Deliver a Cardano-based MVP using CIP-68 NFTs and a public map to verify mangrove plots, increase transparency, expand outreach beyond Cardano, and document the method for adaptation.
title: Plot-Based Tokenization for Verified Mangrove Restoration

problem: New Plutus devs spend 5–10 hrs/week searching fragmented forums. 78% abandon projects due to missing docs; lack of executable examples stalls NFT, stake pool, and dApp development.
solution: Open-source web tool for downloadable Plutus cheatsheets: 50+ snippets (NFTs, multisig), live editor with PDF export, V1–V3 support, and GitHub community submissions, solving fragmented documentation.
title: Plutus Cheatsheet Generator

problem: Vibe coders on cardano lack a dedicated, simulated compiler and playground environment integrated into their workstations for direct testing of  codes without copying and pasting in Plutus playground
solution: An integrated Plutus Compiler and Playground that lives directly in the vibe coders workstation.Removing the need for them to switch to external platforms while coding,making Cardano coding attractive
title: Plutus Compiler and Playground For Vibe Coders

problem: Cardano developers lack an interactive debugger for Plutus contracts, forcing them to debug on-chain, which is slow, costly, and discourages new developers from building reliable dApps.
solution: We will build a VSCode extension that lets developers step through Plutus scripts, inspect variables, and catch errors early, making smart contract development faster, safer, and more accessible.
title: Plutus Debugger Extension for VSCode

problem: Cardano’s weak Plutus tooling forces manual debugging, raising errors by 62% and delaying dApps 3–6 months. With 68% missing deadlines, lack of IDE support risks devs moving to Solana/Ethereum.
solution: Open-source VSCode extension for Plutus: real-time debugging, gas profiling, tx simulation, breakpoints, variable inspection, testnet deploy & wallet emulation. Cuts debug time 40% and reduces errors.
title: Plutus Debugger VSCode Plugin

problem: Plutus Playground lacks beginner-friendly templates, making it hard for new developers to start building smart contracts on Cardano. This slows learning, experimentation, and entry into the ecosystem.
solution: Plutus Playground lacks beginner-friendly templates, making it hard for new developers to start building smart contracts on Cardano. This slows learning, experimentation, and entry into the ecosystem.
title: “Plutus Playground Templates Library”

problem: Prominent Spanish and Portuguese Cardano voices lack visibility due to language barriers and poor outreach, limiting global impact, collaboration, and growth.
solution: Feature LATAM Cardano leaders in Spanish/Portuguese podcast interviews, with English subtitles and written format to share globally.
title: Podcast: Cardano LATAM Voices 🎙️🌎🎧✨

problem: People lost trust in institutions. Online polls are manipulated by bots. Democracy drowns in misinformation. The disenfranchised have no voice. We need authentic democratic infrastructure
solution: Cardano-based platform with 7-segment anti-manipulation polls, three identity modes, Neural Pollinator consensus system, source-tagged discussions, blockchain verification, reputation rewards
title: Pollify.net - Decentralized Governance & Truth Certification

problem: Submitting governance proposals requires a 100K ADA deposit, excluding most ADA holders and preventing smaller stakeholders from participating in Cardano’s governance.
solution: A smart contract platform that pools ADA so holders can collectively meet the 100K deposit, making governance proposal submission easier and more inclusive.
title: Pooling Platform for 100K ADA GA Deposit by Dquadrant

problem: African projects in Catalyst face challenges in delivering practical solutions to local issues, often seen as abstract and disconnected, hindering meaningful Cardano adoption in local communities.
solution: Expand our educational initiative in Cameroon to involve more of the local community by exploring practical prototype dApps, nurturing a Cardano community, and addressing misconceptions about Cardano
title: Practical Cardano dApps for Community Impact

problem: Cardano investors can’t access fast-growing private tech. Most value accrues pre-IPO to insiders; price discovery is opaque, illiquid, and slow.
solution: Perpetual swaps tracking private-company valuations: go long/short with up to 10× leverage; deposit stablecoins for liquidity and fee yield; transparent pricing and on-chain settlemento on Cardano
title: Pre-IPO Perpetuals: Trade Private Companies on Cardano

problem: Prime Wallet lacks support for multiple wallets and mass actions. We aim to add features like one-click delegation and Catalyst voting across all wallets, improving efficiency for users.
solution: We will extend Prime Wallet to support multiple wallets and mass actions, enabling one-click delegation or Catalyst voting across all wallets, simplifying governance and wallet management.
title: Prime Wallet: Mass Voting & Multi-Wallet Actions

problem: New Ethiopian users struggle to set up Cardano wallets due to language barriers, poor internet, and lack of clear offline guides.
solution: We will create clear, printable wallet setup sheets in Amharic, giving Ethiopians offline, step-by-step guidance to join Cardano safely.
title: Printable Cardano Wallet Setup Sheet

problem: Cardano faces a critical shortage of skilled developers building real-world applications on the platform, particularly in places like Latin America.
solution: We will implement an Action Learning Journey (ALJ) in Argentina that combines technical education, community building, and prototype development to onboard 30-50 builders into the Cardano ecosystem.
title: Prisma Argentina Action-Learning Journey

problem: Cardano lacks DID solutions for impact networks, leaving contributions unverifiable. Centralized systems compromise data sovereignty, limiting recognition and fair resource distribution.
solution: Prisma DIDs: Cardano-native solution verifying contributions. Prototype: DID creation, credentials, privacy, access management. Final version adds NFC validation for real-world actions with privacy.
title: Prisma DIDs: Decentralized IDs for Verifiable Contributions

problem: As Cardano seeks to expand their real-world use cases, hackathons offer a pathway for innovation, however technical infrastructure limits developers capabilities to deliver.
solution: Provide Cardano with a full suite of deployable tools to launch Action-learning Journeys Dapps through in-person hackathons pushing local systems innovation.
title: Prisma Potentialise: Action-learning Journeys Orchestrator

problem: "Impact" requires evaluation, defined by local communities. Without accessibility for locals and verification security, external forces dictate future growth pathways.
solution: Voice-based contribution accounting combines the accessibility of voice interface with the security of community-led impact verification protocols, for on-the-ground systems-change.
title: Prisma Timelining: Voice-based Contribution Accounting

problem: Cardano DAOs lack privacy; sensitive votes and treasury actions expose identities and reduce participation.
solution: Private, verifiable DAO voting and treasury management on Cardano, where stakeholders can prove eligibility and voting weight without revealing their identities or balances, powered by Midnight.
title: Privacy-Aware DAO Voting & Treasury Management

problem: International money transfers are often expensive, delayed, and insecure. The reliance on traditional financial systems results in high fees and slow processes, preventing timely access to funds.
solution: We propose developing a P2P platform using Midnight to facilitate fast, secure, and low-cost transnational money transfers with integrated Cardano Self-Sovereign identity (SSI) solution
title: Private Remittances with Midnight

problem: Funded Cardano projects lack a privacy-preserving way to verify event attendance, making it hard to ensure a genuine participation without revealing identities.
solution: Use Decentralized IDs and Zero-Knowledge Proofs to enable privacy-preserving, verifiable attendance for  event  inclusive funded projects.
title: PrivateProof: Anonymous Attendance Verifier

problem: Project management teams struggle with fragmented, non-visual roadmaps that hinder collaboration, stakeholder communication, and data-driven decision-making.
solution: A single platform offering interactive roadmaps, real-time team collaboration, integrated customer insights, and automated sharing to simplify product planning and alignment.
title: Product Compass: A Project Manager's Best Friend

problem: East Africa's vast tech talent lacks practical, hands-on opportunities to build on Cardano. This gap slows local innovation, community growth, and real-world adoption in a key strategic region.
solution: We will launch a social media campaign creating simple, visual content. We'll demystify jargon & showcase real-world Cardano use cases to make the ecosystem welcoming & drive mass adoption.
title: Project "Cardano Clarity"

problem: Low voter participation, concentrated voting power, and unclear Catalyst dRep guidance risk undermining Catalyst’s decentralization vision
solution: Build an open, reusable framework to guide voters and dReps in making informed, transparent, value-aligned decisions, strengthening decentralization and decision quality in Catalyst
title: Project Catalyst dRep Analysis Framework

problem: Catalyst lacks structured incentives for early-stage feedback. Valuable reviews happen too late—after submission—wasting treasury funds and limiting proposals improvement.
solution: Actively offer mentorship during the proposal stage to enable early feedback, improve quality, and support proposers before costly reviews are even triggered.
title: Project Catalyst Mentorship Bureau

problem: Putting trust into new projects is one of the fundamental challenges in seed-funding, since information on new projects is often scarce and scattered around different social media platforms.
solution: Project Insight enables users to swiftly evaluate the credibility of new projects by web scraping relevant information and analyzing public documents.
title: Project Insight: Assessing Trust in Cardano Projects

problem: No Cardano–Midnight bridge exists. General bridges are complex, costly, and hard to trust. Small projects need a safer, simpler way to move only their own tokens from Cardano to Midnight and back.
solution: We build the first project-specific Cardano–Midnight bridge. A trusted model makes token transfers safer, simpler, and open source for projects moving only their own tokens between the two chains.
title: Project-Specific Cardano–Midnight Token Bridge

problem: Students and Alumni lack a trusted, lifelong digital identity and transparent community space. Academic records, funding, and networks remain fragmented, unverifiable, and underutilized.
solution: Unitry is a Hybrid DApp built on Cardano that connects students, alumni, universities, and sponsors through a Tree of Life; an on-chain record of academic and extracurricular achievements, and more.
title: ProjeX UNITRY: University Tree of Life for Students & Alumni

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: Cardano users lack ways to tap environmental markets, capping APY, TVL, and access to transparent environmental RWAs. A native issuance and bridge is needed to unlock scalable, green finance growth.
solution: Thallo bridges verified environmental RWAs to Cardano, enabling on-chain issuance, trading, and retirement to boost APY, TVL, and access to transparent, innovative financial products.
title: Proof-of-Climate: Verified Environmental Assets on Cardano

problem: In Ethiopia, coffee brings people together. This project hosts weekly gatherings where people enjoy coffee, connect, and learn about Cardano in a fun, informal way through games and conversation.
solution: Gathering community for coffee meetups across Ethiopia to address what Cardano is and create an awareness of cardano. Real life use cases in more a friendly, familiar and social environment.
title: Proof of Coffee – Cardano Talks

problem: IoT systems generate valuable environmental and verification data, but current methods rely on centralized storage or unverifiable feeds.
solution: A plug-and-play pipeline linking IoT devices to Cardano, anchoring real-world data as DID NFTs for trustless, verifiable, and reusable applications.
title: Proof of Reality: IoT Data Anchored on Cardano

problem: Cardano proposers face unclear guidance and feedback, causing inefficiencies and rejections in Catalyst funding. The issue also exists across other blockchain ecosystems.
solution: An AI-driven proposal assistant for Catalyst offering live feedback and governance alignment with APIs for cross-chain adoption to support wider Web3 communities and clear Multilingual tips.
title: ProposalGPT: AI Co-Pilot with On-Chain Archiving for Cardano

problem: If you suffer Cardano asset theft, you have no effective remedies available to recover your stolen assets. Law enforcement lacks crypto expertise and recovery services are extremely expensive.
solution: CoverCrypto is a membership that covers the cost of recovering stolen crypto, making crypto recovery services available and affordable. Insured by Lloyd's of London syndicates.
title: Protecting your Cardano portfolio with CoverCrypto.io

problem: Cardano's isolation from other networks blocks critical flows of data and assets. This lack of interoperability severely limits ecosystem growth, dApp innovation, and access to new liquidity.
solution: We'll build an open-source protocol using on-chain smart contracts and an off-chain relayer. This framework creates a secure bridge for Cardano to transfer assets and data with other networks.
title: PROTOFIRE - Cardano Cross-Chain Interoperability Protocol

problem: Cardano smart contract development remains complex, with scattered tools and a steep learning curve, hindering ecosystem growth and developer adoption.
solution: Dev Studio v2 provides an integrated development environment with VS Code extension, streamlining Cardano smart contract creation, testing, and deployment across multiple languages.
title: PROTOFIRE - Developer Studio v2

problem: ADA Handles can hold website/contact info metadata but no context-aware discovery of this information exists. We lack semantic search, preventing community connection pathways and project showcasing.
solution: Privacy-first semantic search engine for Handles. Discovers handles by meaning not just text, surfaces owner website/contact info via metadata, drives on-chain updates. Handles leveraged as linktrees.
title: PSEUDONYMOUS COMPUTER: The Handle Search Engine

problem: Integration Complexity: 3rd-party developers (Wallets, DeFi Aggregators, Bots, Liquidity Provider...) lack of standardized documentation and stable APIs to interact with Danogo Lending protocols.
solution:
An API system covering core functionalities of the lending dApp (Pool management, Loan lifecycle activities)
- Ensure availability/scalability
- Support for future features
title: Public API & Integration Guide for Cardano Lending Protocols

problem: Cardano’s growth in Africa is held back by scarce local-language education. Millions are excluded from learning, building, and adopting due to this critical knowledge gap
solution: We will publish Cardano knowledge in 10+ widely spoken African languages, making blockchain education accessible, breaking barriers, and accelerating adoption across the continent.
title: Publishing Cardano Knowledge in Africa’s 10 Key Tongues

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: PubWeave is an academic publishing platform with a peer review payment system deployed on Cardano's mainnet that lacks distributed decision-making mechanisms and mainstream awareness.
solution: A three-pronged solution that includes a marketing communication plan (user attraction), UI/UX enhancements (user retention), and on/off-chain moderation and governance tools (value proposition).
title: PubWeave: Decentralized Peer Reviews

problem: Python/AI developers lack a clear learning path for Cardano. Existing PyCardano docs are scattered and complex, creating a high barrier for this massive talent pool to build on our ecosystem.
solution: Build the free PyCardano learning course with video tutorials, code templates, and project-based guides. This removes the entry barrier, onboarding thousands of new Python devs to Cardano.
title: PyCardano: The Ultimate Course for Python and AI Developers

problem: Catalyst and Intersect lack unified on-chain and off-chain auditing, enabling double-dipping, washing, self dealing, inefficiency, and poor RoI oversight, risking treasury waste
solution: Pilot audit: review 200 projects (150 Catalyst, 50 Intersect), build real-time fund tracking tool, publish anomaly reports to prove value, and guide expansion of on-chain and off-chain oversight.
title: Quality Assurance: On-Chain & Off-Chain Audit

problem: Employees face burnout, job-hopping is fulfilling but risky and frowned upon, current job sites no longer fit for purpose, AI making many redundant without fresh alternatives available.
solution: A blockchain-based utility loaded with career history, skills, and certifications, minted as a unique NFT for job rotation opportunities that combat burnout,a job concierge service suited for nomads
title: Quattro - Work for 4 Companies At Once, Use 1 Cardano NFT

problem: Existing oracles are limited, as they provide only a narrow set of data. This slows down the development of DeFi and RWA projects and also makes them less secure.
solution: QUEX’s hardware-level cryptographic oracles use Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) to fetch and notarize HTTPS requests, ensuring secure, verifiable, and tamper-proof data transfer on-chain.
title: Quex oracles

problem: 70+ years ago in Cameroon, France crushed the UPC movement, then installed loyalists; today militarized rule blocks protest, pushing movements to secure, borderless digital tools.
solution: R-UPC meme token to unite a UPC-aligned community, plant NFTrees for land & food sovereignty, enable uncensored governance, fund aligned leaders, and debate & design a currency fit for Cameroon.
title: R-UPC: Meme Token Powering Change in Cameroon and beyond

problem: Raffles and lotteries are powerful growth and fundraising tools. But without credibly trustless randomness, transparent fund flows, and a smooth UX, creators and charities avoid them.
solution: Upgrade https://www.raffleize.art  into a mainnet-ready platform for fair, on-chain raffles, including crowdfounding raffles and pot lotteries —secure, transparent, and open to all Cardano users.
title: Raffleize: On-Chain Crowdfunding Raffles & Pot Lotteries

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: Rainforest Alliance aims to pilot blockchain technology to enhance traceability and value for sustainable forest products, without introducing complexity or risk to CFEs or buyers.
solution: A Cardano-backed MVP for traceability and label integrity, with a modular roadmap for product cataloging, buyer capture, and future smart contracts. Partnerships like ScanTrust may be explored.
title: Rainforest Alliance: Blockchain Traceability Pilot

problem: Rapid DEX’s funded prototype proved batcher-less pools cut fees, speed trades, and boost decentralization. Mainnet launch needs extra features for UX, efficiency, and sustainability.
solution: We will extend Rapid DEX from testnet PoC to mainnet with fee control, treasuries, zap liquidity, routing, and modular features for fully decentralized, user-centric DEX
title: Rapid DEX: Mainnet-Ready, Batcher-Free & Advanced Features

problem: The current development lifecycle for Plutus applications is slow and complex, making it challenging for developers to build decentralized applications (dApps) on Cardano quickly.
solution: We will develop rPAD - Pheidippides, a rapid application development platform that streamlines the creation of Plutus smart contracts and dApps on Cardano.
title: rapid Plutus Application Development (rPAD)- Pheidippides

problem: Many Catalyst proposals fail due to unclear writing or weak structure. New proposers struggle to meet requirements, leading to preventable rejections.
solution: An AI-powered review platform that scores proposals, detects missing parts, and gives improvement tips before submission to Catalyst.
title: Rate My Proposal AI Tool

problem: There is no trustless, permissionless gaming system on Cardano that connects on-chain play with real-world value.
solution: Reafino SmartPlay is a RealFi games module starting with a fully on-chain permissionless, trustless games of chance, linked to RealFi use cases. Fair and manipulation resistant contract design.
title: Reafino SmartPlay: Fully on-chain games with a RealFi angle

problem: Real-world economic activities are not yet linked to DeFi and there is a vacuum of smart contract driven RealFi products on Cardano.
solution: Smart contract audit and mainnet launch of Reafino SmartStarter dApp. Connecting DeFi capital with crowdfunding that’s fully trustless and permissionless via Cardano smart contracts.
title: Reafino SmartStarter dApp: Audit & Mainnet Launch

problem: Real estate projects require cross border funding called FDI (foreign direct investment) in form of lending. High friction cost is involved and lot of legal criteria needs to be satisfied.
solution: Peer to peer lending will lower the friction cost. Legal implications will be taken care of by AI aided document verification and VC (verifiable credentials issuance). DAO and Defi will be combined.
title: Real estate cross border fund management platform

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: Real estate is costly, slow, and illiquid, blocking small investors. Existing tokenization lacks compliance or global access, leaving a gap for a secure, Cardano-based real estate solution.
solution: Partnering with Vierci Development, we’ll build a Cardano-based platform for high-yield RWA real estate tokenization, enabling fractional ownership with integrated KYC/AML and smart contracts.
title: Real Estate Tokenization Powered by Cardano

problem: Cardano traders lack a secure Telegram bot for convenient trading and real-time price tracking, limiting speed, safety, and adoption.
solution: A Telegram bot for tracking, alerting, and executing trades the tokens on Cardano in real-time using on-chain data, helping users act faster and smarter.
title: Real-Time Trading and Alerts for all token pairs on Cardano

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: Cardano needs to realize real world adoption to achieve long-term ecosystem sustainability.  This initiative will proliferate Cardano payment support and visibility into existing vending machines.
solution: DripDropz is collaborating with Remarc Vending to enable their existing fleet of thousands of vending machines to accept cryptocurrency payments. This proposal brings real world adoption to Caradno
title: Real World Adoption: Cardano Payments in Vending Machines

problem: Real estate Pre-sales by developers lack auditable progress, standard evidence and timely certifications, causing distrust, delays and costly disputes for developers and avoidable risk for buyers
solution: Cardano turns pre-sales into proof: identity verified, contracts e-signed, funds locked in milestone escrow, evidence on-chain, and releases or refunds executed automatically, opening up new markets,
title: Real-World Real Estate Pre-Sale with Proof & Release

problem: Without verifiable AI reasoning, Cardano dApps face risks in governance, compliance, and real-world adoption.
solution: ReasonChain enables Cardano dApps to verify AI outputs via ZK proofs of model version, input/output integrity, policy safety, and CoT commitments with optional identity credentials.
title: ReasonChain — ZK-Attested AI Chain-of-Thought Oracle

problem: Tigray has endured years of conflict, leaving communities displaced and struggling. Women, youth, and children lack trust, support, and access to opportunities to join the global digital economy.
solution: This project aims to introduce blockchain and Cardano literacy as a tool for hope  and empowerment in war-affected communities of Tigray. Through community dialogues, and youth focused education hubs
title: Rebuilding Lives on Chain: Cardano for Tigray Recovery

problem: Cardano's development and knowledge resources are an immense space, complex, scattered, and hard to navigate—discouraging newcomers and limiting global adoption, collaboration, and innovation.
solution: We’ll unify and simplify Cardano’s Dev ecosystem into an interactive platform with an online Plutus playground, better UX, and centralized access to key dev and knowledge resources.
title: Redefining Cardano Access and Innovation for All

problem: Reef Data lets users request, understand, and monetize their data. Monetization requires off-device transfer, risking loss of control and transparency unless decentralized infrastructure is used.
solution: Reef Data (by Volksbank Hamburg) will validate IAGON’s patented decentralized tech by building a PoC data layer, letting users control, track, and monetize data with sovereignty and auditability.
title: Reef Data: IAGON and Cardano as Data Layers for Data Coop

problem: Companies using ERPs like TOTVS Protheus face challenges in ensuring full integrity, transparency, and auditability, as reports generated within the system may be altered without complete traceability
solution: Integrate Reeve by Cardano Foundation with the TOTVS Protheus ERP, ensuring that critical data (transactions, invoices, balance sheets, and accounting reports) are securely recorded on the blockchain.
title: Reeve's integration with Largest ERP in LATAM TOTVS Protheus

problem: LatAm has bright talent but little access to up to date and specialized Cardano training. High costs and outdated courses block careers and limit the region’s voice in the decentralized economy.
solution: A 20 week, zero upfront Cardano bootcamp. Learn technical and soft skills by building real dApps, then repay interest-free after employment, creating a self-sustaining cycle that continually expands.
title: Regenerative Cardano Bootcamp for Latin America

problem: Cardano builders face uncertainty navigating fast-changing global crypto regulations; they lack accessible, ongoing legal insights to anticipate risks and stay compliant.
solution: A monthly digest delivering clear, founder-friendly updates on global crypto laws, risks, and cases, empowering Cardano builders to stay compliant and informed.
title: Regulatory Watch: Monthly Digest & Risk Radar

problem: E-waste is growing fast, yet only 22.3% is collected. No system exists—leaving toxic leaks, no incentives, and little data. This “intention–action gap” harms health, environment, and development.
solution: ReLoop is a Cardano-powered circular economy for e-waste, using smart bins, token rewards, and DAO governance to drive recycling, empower IDPs, and deliver social and environmental impact.
title: ReLoop: Turning E-Waste into Wealth through Cardano

problem: Persistent myths (“ghost chain,” “not decentralized”) spread online, confusing newcomers and deterring builders. Misinformation clouds Cardano’s image and slows adoption.
solution: Map top Cardano myths, research why they stick, and turn evidence-based refutations into 30–90s shorts + a creator playbook—shareable tools that correct FUD and help the community spread the truth.
title: Research-Backed Viral Shorts to Bust Cardano Myths

problem: Rampant job scams in Indonesia, with 7000+ victims losing millions in total, combined with inefficient hiring processes make recruitment slow, costly, and stressful for both companies and jobseekers.
solution: A job platform where jobseekers can review employers on-chain and enhance profiles via AI-led interviews, making hiring faster and more trustworthy.
title: Retrai: AI Recruitment Platform with Cardano-Verified Trust

problem: Professional bodies face challenges with opaque/ ambiguous governance processes and lack of accountability, leading to reduced trust and inefficiencies.
solution: Use Cardano blockchain to create transparent, immutable records and smart contract-based governance, boosting accountability, trust, and efficiency in professional bodies.
title: Revolutionizing Professional Accountability on Cardano

problem: In Vietnam, waste isn't sorted at the source (>80% unsorted). The current system lacks transparency and traceability , and there are no real incentives to encourage citizens' green behavior.
solution: ReWasteChain uses Cardano to build a transparent waste management system. We reward citizens with tokens for sorting waste, tracked via QR codes, ensuring verifiable data for authorities.
title: ReWasteChain

problem: Most Ethiopians have never heard of Cardano we're changing that with boots on the ground, we'll bring Cardano to life through street banners & printed guides no internet needed, just real connection.
solution: We’ll promote Cardano via bike/car banners, free blockchain comic style books, trifold brochure, QR codes, and street workshops, bringing engaging, offline education directly to Ethiopia’s public.
title: Ride the Future: Promoting Cardano Through Motion & Media

problem: There's no simple, customizable protocol allowing groups of people to pool assets & knowledge, decide on trading strategies, vote with governance, and then execute trades.
solution: DAO Vaults that (1) pool assets, (2) mint vault tokens, (3) offer dynamic governance voting, (4) execute strategies with logic based robo-trading, and (5) distribute proceeds to holders.
title: Robo-trading Asset Vaults: Unlock Group Trading & Investing

problem: Fixed-term loans on Cardano require manual renewal. Borrowers must repay and create new loans, losing their position. This reduces efficiency, limits long-term borrowing strategies.
solution: We will build a rolling loan mechanism that lets borrowers extend fixed-term loans or switch to flexible terms without full repayment, reducing costs while keeping collateral locked and yield active.
title: Rolling Loans: Continuous Borrowing on Danogo

problem: Cardano’s DeFi is still early stage with TVL under $300M (<1% of Ethereum’s). It lags behind Ethereum and Solana, needing growth as ADA treasury funds shrink and fees alone can’t sustain it.
solution: Building the ROSCA prototype on Cardano—a DeFi platform for savings and capital raising, offering interest-based returns that are flexible, scalable, and globally accessible for all users.
title: ROSCA: Decentralized Savings & Fund Pool utilizes Cardano-SC

problem: To boost Cardano's adoption in Ethiopia, we should create a large scale public event in Addis Ababa that connects Cardano with a popular activity like running.
solution: To expand Cardano's reach, we'll host a 10K running contest in Addis Ababa. This event will connect the community, promote health, and introduce the public to the Cardano blockchain.
title: Run for Cardano: Addis Ababa 10KM Challenge!

problem: People in these wealthy areas in general have no clue what blockchain is, esp. no clue what Real World Assets on the blochchain means. But they are a huge wealthy target group.
solution: Bring awareness to the target group. Educate them about blockchain and esp. RWAs. I'm well connected there. Live tokenization demonstrations.
title: RWA/ blockchain attention camps in Gstaad and Montreux

problem: We propose a lightweight cross-chain adapter to bridge stablecoins (USDC/USDT) into Cardano for RWA yield distribution and treasury inflows on RWA Genius Yield.
solution: A cross-chain adapter to bring stablecoins (e.g. USDC) from Ethereum/Solana into Cardano, enabling seamless yield distribution and treasury funding for RWA DeFi protocols like RWA Genius Yield.
title: RWA Cross-Chain Bridge Adapter for Stablecoin Distribution

problem: Most Cardano OTC trades happen in unverified chats, leading to scams, disputes, and lost trust. No shared identity, escrow, or reputation system exists to protect traders and communities.
solution: We’ll build Reputa Market - a decentralized OTC platform with smart contract escrow, trader profiles, and human-verified reputation to make Cardano trades safe, transparent, and trust-driven.
title: Safe & Trusted OTC Trading with Reputation on Cardano

problem: .NET lacks a canonical CBOR library for all Cardano eras. Chrysalis.CBOR fills this gap but needs ongoing maintenance and DeFi types to prevent redundant implementations.
solution: Maintain Chrysalis.CBOR as .NET's canonical Cardano library. Add 10+ DeFi protocol types with full CDDL coverage, ensuring cross-era compatibility and production reliability.
title: SAIB: Chrysalis.CBOR – .NET's CBOR (De)serialization Engine

problem: .NET lacks native Ouroboros protocols for reliable node participation. Chrysalis.Network exists but needs critical missing protocols to enable full network interaction and tooling.
solution: Continue developing and maintaining Chrysalis.Network, implementing BlockFetch, TxSubmission, KeepAlive, PeerSharing, and LocalTxMonitor for complete protocol coverage and reliable node participation.
title: SAIB: Chrysalis.Network – Ouroboros Protocols for .NET

problem: UPLC scripts need core runtime primitives (crypto, hashing, data operations) which .NET lacks, blocking native smart contract evaluation for C# developers building Cardano applications.
solution: We will implement all Plutus runtime primitives in C#: crypto, hashing, data operations, and arithmetic, creating a complete production-ready environment for smart contract evaluation.
title: SAIB: Chrysalis.Plutus.Builtins - Core Runtime Operations

problem: .NET developers cannot natively parse or evaluate UPLC. Without heavy FFI bridges to Rust or Haskell, 7-8M C# developers are blocked from building on Cardano.
solution: We will build a pure C# UPLC parser and CEK engine, enabling .NET developers to run Cardano scripts natively with full performance and no external dependencies.
title: SAIB: Chrysalis.Plutus.Core - Parser & CEK Engine for .NET

problem: Developers need production tools to use Plutus evaluation: cost calculation, context building, CLI automation. Raw primitives aren't enough for real development workflows.
solution: We will build complete SDK: cost model, script context builder, CLI tools, high-level API. Production-ready developer experience for .NET Cardano development.
title: SAIB: Chrysalis.Plutus.SDK - Developer Tools & Integration

problem: .NET lacks a production-ready Cardano transaction builder. Chrysalis.Tx exists but needs comprehensive testing, maintenance, and advanced features to become the canonical solution.
solution: Transform Chrysalis.Tx into .NET's canonical transaction builder through comprehensive testing, enhanced template engine, smart coin selection, and full provider APIs for production use.
title: SAIB: Chrysalis.Tx – Advanced Transaction Building for .NET

problem: Cardano governance risks being dominated by a narrow set of insiders. Many Ada holders, especially in developing economies, lack the tools and knowledge to participate effectively.
solution: We will run workshops, maintain SanchoNet, produce guides, infographics, and videos, and build a mentorship network to train, support, and empower a global pool of Cardano governance leaders.
title: SanchoNet Education Network Governance Resources

problem: Momentum from the Sandbox25 event is fading. Students lack follow-up training and access, jeopardizing Cardano's potential to build Africa's largest student-led blockchain movement.
solution: We will take the Cardano movement nationwide by organizing state-level workshops in central cities of  36 states of Nigeria. Developer, Governance, DRep Onboarding Bootcamps & Constitutional Workshops
title: Sandbox Consolidation A Nationwide Push for Cardano Adoption

problem: Donors face fraud risk in charity. This problem persists because current solutions lack on-chain economic guarantees, making trust a critical point of failure.
solution: We empower donors with security by building an open-source Plutus V3 smart contract that enables the novel, verifiable Crypto-Collateralized Receiver (CCR) mechanism.
title: SaoMai: Collateral-Backed Donations, Secured by Cardano

problem: Enterprises using SAP have no secure, standardized way to connect with the Cardano blockchain, limiting adoption for supply chain, finance, and ESG use cases.
solution: Develop an open-source OData API with SAP CAP that lets SAP systems securely read blockchain data and submit transactions to Cardano. Enabling enterprise blockchain integration at scale.
title: SAP–Cardano OData V4 API with CAP & SAP-Cardano SDK

problem: Extend Cardano node availability and decentralized data storage to orbit.
solution: Develop spaceflight hardware for Cardano and data storage infrastructure
title: Satellite Hardware R&D for Cardano & Decentralized Data Node

problem: There are signficant gaps in existing social platforms to support collaborative investigation of real world events and store the related evidence/intelligence.
solution: sauce.cafe is a decentralised social platform with tools to discuss and investigate any topic, store and make sense of the evidence and leverage the collective intelligence of all people.
title: sauce.cafe – Decentralised social intelligence platform

problem: Presently, Cardano developers face a fragmented toolset  and setting up a full Haskell-based Plutus development environment is notoriously complex
solution: Scaffold Cardano is a full-stack development framework designed to simplify building DApps on Cardano. Leveraging from Ethereum’s Scaffold-ETH.
title: Scaffold Cardano: Aiken Development Toolkit

problem: Paraguayans face predatory high-interest loans, limiting financial inclusion and keeping families and individuals trapped in cycles of debt.
solution: A Cardano-based microfinance platform built for an existing Paraguayan cooperative, offering low-interest loans repayable in ADA or stablecoins via mobile wallets with full transparency.
title: Scalable Cooperative Microlending dApp

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: Our K-12 financial edtech platform handles millions of profiles and payments monthly, yet remains siloed, slow, opaque, and lacking trusted interoperability.
solution: Integrating Cardano as single source of truth for our K-12 financial edtech ecosystem, enabling transparent, compliant millions of monthly transactions & onboarding millions of verified users annualy.
title: Scaling Cardano Adoption via K-12 Financial EdTech Platform

problem: Part of Cardano unfocus includes, structured African developer communities to turn Education into open source contributions, leaving new talent underutilized in the ecosystem growth and participation
solution: After the Education of Gimbalabs African Developers Education initiative, we’re launching BlockPrint, and expanding collaboration, learning/Education, and building real Cardano projects in Africa.
title: Scaling Cardano Innovation - BlockPrint Developers Community

problem: We solve the lack of engaging, high-quality Cardano content in Spanish by upgrading our podcast setup to reach and educate the Hispanic community
solution: Upgrading our setup lets us share clearer, richer Cardano content that connects, educates, and grows the Spanish-speaking community.
title: Scaling Cardano’s Voice in Latin America

problem: Hunger persists due to broken supply chains, weak tracking, and poor accountability—up to 30% of aid is lost, wasting billions and eroding trust in humanitarian response.
solution: We will build ScanPro, an AI-powered humanitarian track & trace system on Cardano that ensures food aid is monitored, verified, and delivered efficiently, cutting waste and boosting transparency.
title: ScanPro: Next-Gen Humanitarian Track & Trace on Cardano

problem: Cardano has new projects releasing or updates to existing ones all the time. This requires continuous effort to educate and incentivize our community to properly research them and share results.
solution: We hold monthly DYOR competitions using our in house tool, https://dyortool.io/ , to promote the Cardano ecosystem, encourage deep research, improve research skills, and uncover bad actors
title: SCATDAO Monthly DYOR Competitions and Scam Monitoring

problem: Southeast Asia (especially in Vietnam & Singapore) lacks structured programs to train uni students and early developers in Cardano, hindering the growth of skilled blockchain talent across the region.
solution: We'll host a regional hackathon and training workshops to attract, engage, and mentor Southeast Asia’s undergraduates and early developers, cultivating a skilled talent pool to drive Cardano’s growth.
title: SEA Hackathon: Shaping Southest Asia's Next Cardano Builders

problem: Buying and selling tokens is still complex, requiring exchanges, custody risks, and multiple steps. This friction blocks adoption and mainstream Web3 access.
solution: A seamless fiat to Cardano token on/off-ramp via API and widget, enabling instant VISA/SEPA/ApplePay/GooglePay payments, with tokens sent directly to wallets. Fast, non-custodial, compliant, seamless.
title: Seamless FIAT to Cardano token on/off ramp

problem: Cardano governance struggles with healthy collaboration, limiting its ability to deliver transformative, decentralized change.
solution: Continue delivering the ODIN Season of Collaboration, fostering learning and development in community governance practices, increasing active participation and skill capacity and breaking down silos
title: Seasons of Collaboration: Funding the ODIN Initiative

problem: Radicle.xyz lacks clear incentives and guidance for seeding code, limiting participation and slowing the growth of decentralized open source collaboration.
solution: Create a tokenomic model rewarding users for renting compute to seed Radicle.xyz repositories, boosting decentralized code availability and community engagement.
title: SeedCoin: Tokenizing Radicle to Grow Cardano’s Dev Roots

problem: Cardano lacks advanced trading tools and efficient execution routes, making it hard for active traders to operate competitively within the ecosystem
solution: We will build a trading platform focus on technical analysis and AI assistant, support users in trading on Cardano
title: SeerBOT: The next generation trading platform on Cardano

problem: Traditional businesses struggle to find verified Cardano developers, legal experts, and consultants, limiting enterprise adoption.
solution: Semoto creates a dedicated Cardano vertical within their existing marketplace, featuring curated listings of Cardano-specialized service providers, educational resources
title: Semoto Cardano Professional Services Hub

problem: Current RFP processes lack transparency, security, and verifiable bidder credentials, leading to fraud and inefficient project matching.
solution: Semoto builds RFP/RFQ functionality into their existing marketplace with UVerify identity verification for bidders, Cardano smart contract escrow for payments and on-chain reputation scoring.
title: Semoto RFP/RFQ Platform with Cardano Integration

problem: Web3 service providers on Semoto lack standardized, portable reputation credentials, making it difficult for businesses to assess trustworthiness across platforms.
solution: Semoto integrates UVerify + Cardano Native Token credentials into their existing platform, allowing service providers to earn verifiable professional badges displayed on profiles
title: Semoto Verifiable Professional Credentials

problem: Cardano struggles with fragmented narratives, poor launch coordination, and limited outreach beyond its core community, weakening visibility, engagement, and growth in the broader crypto space.
solution: Sendr is a decentralized DAO powering Cardano’s voice. It unites top creators to deliver impactful, coordinated campaigns that amplify visibility, strengthen trust, and accelerate ecosystem growth.
title: Sendr: A DAO to hack the X algorithm and push ADA narratives

problem: Romanian e-commerce lacks AI-powered sentiment analysis tools, limiting businesses' ability to understand customer feedback and make data-driven decisions in their native language.
solution: Sentiant-RO will deploy a specialized Romanian AI agent on Masumi Network, trained on 100k Romanian product reviews to provide accurate sentiment analysis with Cardano-based payments.
title: Sentiant-RO 🤖 - Romanian AI Agent on Masumi Network

problem: Ethiopian artisans, weavers, and musicians lack fair market access. Middlemen take value, while high-cost, inaccessible NFT platforms block creators from global visibility.
solution: Build a Cardano-based MVP NFT marketplace with low-cost minting, fair royalties, and simple onboarding for Ethiopian creators.
title: Sheba Create: Empowering Ethiopian Artisans on Cardano

problem: Ethiopian football bleeds: youth turn away as clubs starve. Fake merch floods markets; fans can’t buy real gear or fund teams. Loyalty is empty promises. Clubs die passive deaths. ⚽🇪🇹

solution: A universal DApp to trace virtually anything, on Cardano - enabling any user or business to track assets, activities, or records across any industry and beyond.
