problem: TradFi liquidity & data are locked in legacy systems and cannot be used trustlessly in Cardano dApps without exposing sensitive info or relying on intermediaries, limiting real-world Web3 integration.
solution: An open-source SDK with Midnight ZK proofs bridging TradFi systems to Cardano, enabling private and trustless use of TradFi data and liquidity for smart contract triggers without revealing raw data.
title: TradFi MidnightZK SDK – Bridge Banking to Cardano DeFi

problem: Vietnam is a top crypto market but lacks localized Cardano resources. Cardano for the Masses exists only as an intro eBook, leaving developers without practical Aiken materials in Vietnamese.
solution: We propose to translate and publish I Can Aiken in Vietnamese as free open-sourced eBook and 1,000 printed copies, with media promotion to empower Vietnam Cardano’s builder community.
title: Translate & Publish "I Can Aiken" Book to Vietnamese

problem: Cardano is Ready for Business: this means Cardano is looking for real world use cases, one example of which can very well be allowing people to purchase travel vacations and insurance.
solution: I will investigate the current state of travel and vacation planning in NL, LX, BE, & DE joining the relevant bodies ANVR (anvr.nl) SDR (sdr.nl) along with reaching out to de VakantieDiscounter
title: Travel and Vacation Insurance

problem: Funded teams may pledge to return ADA to the Treasury if successful, but no standard tool exists to track or monitor these repayments across projects.
solution: Let's create Treasury Guardian: a tool that issues proof of registration (PoR) before a proposal submission, then monitors and reports ADA repayments to the Treasury. Teams can register without PoR.
title: Treasury Guardian

problem: Compromised clinical trial data, due to errors or manipulation, leads to unreliable results, undermining trust and delaying the approval of safe treatments, ultimately risking public health.
solution: TrialNet secures clinical trial data with Aiken smart contracts and NFTs, reducing breaches, boosting transparency, and ensuring compliance, allowing companies to manage trials safely and build trust.
title: TrialNet: Open Source Clinical Trials Powered by Aiken

problem: Tribal communities manage collective assets and need transparent, culturally aligned DAOs, but complex technical barriers block adoption and self-determination.
solution: Develop a technical blueprint for TribalDAOs with architecture, smart contracts, and UX frameworks to lower barriers for culturally aligned DAOs on Cardano.
title: TribalDAOs Technical Blueprint

problem: There is no social network application that cater for the Africa diaspora that want to stay in touch with families across the continent, and enable transactions between family members across borders.
solution: Our solution aims to bring in social networing of groups (tribes) with additional transactional capabilities for funding and purchasing essentials within your own Tribe through the African way.
title: Tribes - the new social network for Africa

problem: Brazilian foreign trade sector lacks a transparent, immutable, and auditable system to track import and export transactions and documents, leading to inefficiencies, fraud, and money laundering risks.
solution: A decentralized application built on Cardano that provides a blockchain-backed system for registering and auditing Import Declarations, associated documents, and user transaction histories.
title: TrImEx: Transparent Import/Export Platform

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: Product reviews in Vietnam & SEA are fragmented, easily manipulated, and often paid for. No trusted platform exists to ensure authentic, tamper-proof reviews accessible to all.
solution: We will build a blockchain-based social platform on Cardano where all product reviews are immutable, transparent, and traceable, ensuring trust and authenticity for consumers and businesses.
title: Trusted Product Reviews on Cardano Blockchain

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: Product data, certificates, and licenses are often unclear or altered. Consumers, regulatory lack access to trusted, immutable information, with no reliable intermediary.
solution: We will build a blockchain platform for product data and certificates, accessible via iCheck app, ensuring transparent, tamper-proof info for consumers and regulators.
title: Trusted Product Transparency on Blockchain

problem: Enabling cross-chain trading for ADA against native BTC, ETH and other assets without the use of bridges or wrapping as they have historically had security issues
solution: Our solution will be to enable HTLC-based atomic swaps for ADA to directly swap between many different blockchains without the need of wrapping or bridging.
title: Trustless Cross-Chain Atomic Swaps for Cardano

problem: There’s no reputation/rating framework for DReps in Cardano Governance. This is a vulnerability, making it difficult for delegators to make informed decisions when selecting a DRep
solution: We propose an open-source scoring framework for DReps, like Trustpilot, featuring customizable algorithms for rating DReps based on parameters like on-chain activity, social media engagement & more
title: TrustPilot for DReps: On-Chain Rating & Reviews Framework

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: Cardano lags competitors (BSC, Avalanche, Base) by lacking a full-service launchpad. Teams rely on fragmented tools/scripts, pushing launches to other chains and hurting adoption, TVL, and retention.
solution: We’ll integrate Cardano with TrustSwap and run a white-label launchpad with STORM incubation and MLabs integration, delivering KYC fundraising, token tools, and a discovery hub.
title: TrustSwap(TS), STORM & MLabs: Cardano TS Integration + WL

problem: Users have lost $300M+ due to unreadable, complex transaction messages. This opens the door to costly mistakes and scams, eroding trust in Web3.
solution: TrustTX SDK converts complex Tx details into simple language using AI to help users understand exactly what they're signing. Easy to integrate SDK enhances transparency and security for wallets.
title: TrustTx AI SDK: Simplify Cardano Tx Signing To Avoid Scams

problem: Across African, millions of  people engage in daily physical activity, yet there is no blockchain system that rewards their effort of promoting good health practices.
solution: The project aims at developing a cardano-based mobile app rewards daily steps with tokens, linking wellness to financial empowerment and driving blockchain use across Africa.
title: Turning Daily Steps into Digital Value with Cardano

problem: Developers using Aiken face significant challenges when testing smart contracts, as they lack tools to easily construct transactions and verify them in conditions that closely reflect the protocol.
solution: Build a testing framework for Aiken that improves the developer testing experience and accurately simulates Cardano protocol transactions and on-chain conditions
title: TxCheck: An Aiken Framework for Tx Testing and Simulation

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: Typhon lacks multi-signature support, limiting secure collaboration in managing ADA, tokens, and staking among organizations and teams.
solution: Implement native script-based multi-sig in Typhon, enabling secure multi-party management of ADA, tokens, and staking with an intuitive UI.
title: Typhon Wallet - Secure Multi-Signature Support

problem: IT students need engaging, hands-on programs with mentorship and peer support, not boring text materials that discourage blockchain learning.
solution: Provide free developer bootcamps and hackathons for university students, covering basic to advanced Cardano concepts with hands-on mentorship
title: [UBA] University Cardano Developer Bootcamp & Hackathon

problem: Informal African businesses lack access to credit, stifling growth, innovation, and stability, trapping entrepreneurs in poverty and limiting economic potential.
solution: A Cardano-based cooperative smart contract offers secure, transparent credit for Africa’s informal businesses, boosting growth, trust, and inclusion while reducing dependence on traditional finance.
title: Ubuntu dApp: Cardano Decentralized Business Empowerment

problem: Cardano lacks a unified, structured learning hub. Resources are scattered, making it difficult for newcomers and developers to learn, onboard, and grow within the ecosystem.
solution: An online hub for Cardano education where experts publish courses, learners gain skills, and completion is verified with blockchain-based certificates.
title: Udemy for Cardano

problem: Game developers lack simple tools to use Cardano NFTs in Unreal Engine 5, blocking adoption in gaming and limiting Cardano’s GameFi potential.
solution: UE5 plugin integrating NMKR APIs for NFT ownership checks and checkout, with Blueprint/C++ tools to seamlessly bring Cardano NFTs into games.
title: UE NMKR Connect 🔌 - Cardano NFT Plugin for Unreal Engine 5

problem: Right now, there aren’t enough fun, competitive games on Cardano to pull in new players from outside the ecosystem. Most gamers still don’t know what Cardano is or what projects are building here.
solution: Create a Cardano version of Ultimate Domination with a 42-territory map tied to real projects, player battles, and tournaments to grow the gaming community and onboard new users.
title: Ultimate Domination: Bringing More Gamers to Cardano

problem: Cardano lacks an engaging, user-friendly dashboard for non-technical people to explore key chain metrics like onchain usage, governance and DeFi. Existing tools focus more on developers experience.
solution: Develop a visually appealing dashboard inspired by Ethereum's ultrasound.money, emphasizing Cardano's core strength in decentralization. It will present key onchain, DeFi and governance metrics
title: UltraDecentralised.money:  Cardano Metrics Hub

problem: Cardano lacks an open, unified DEX analytics solution, forcing developers to rely on closed or fragmented tools instead of transparent data to track liquidity, trading patterns, and claims.
solution: We will deliver an open-source, unified DEX analytics tool for Cardano, enabling developers to track liquidity, detect trading patterns, and fact-check data with transparent insights.
title: Unified Open Analytics for Cardano DeFi

problem: Cardano lacks a unified, open-source tool to track DAO metrics like participation, treasury activity, and growth, making it hard for users to stay informed across the growing number of DAO platforms.
solution: We aim to build an open-source analytics platform aggregating DAO data on Cardano, tracking governance activity, community engagement, and treasury movements across all major DAO frameworks.
title: Unified Open Source DAO Analytics for Cardano

problem: Cardano DeFi lacks aggregators with MEV-resistant execution, leaving users exposed to front-running and limiting ecosystem competitiveness versus EVM and Solana.
solution: UNIKRON brings an intent-based, MEV-resistant meta-DEX aggregator to Cardano, integrating local DEXs with routing for secure, fair and competitive DeFi trading.
title: UNIKRON – an intent-based meta-DEX aggregator

problem: Current digital certificates are vulnerable to fraud, lack standardization, and are hard to verify globally even cardano education platfrom, limiting trust between students, employers & institutions.
solution: Provide Global Skill Certification Platform, powered by AI & Cardano, to issue tamper-proof, publicly verifiable certificate for all skill & achievement be it academic, professional or community-based
title: Universal Skill Certification Platform (Cardano-Powered)

problem: Argentine universities show high interest in blockchain yet lack concrete low-risk paths, verifiable academic processes and credentialing tools - keeping enthusiasm high but real Cardano adoption low
solution: Turn a proven forum into a Cardano-powered adoption program: issue on-chain credentials, shocase panels, keynotes, and work tables that onboard participants and produce actionable plans.
title: University Forum in Argentina - Powered by Cardano

problem: Lack of Cardano devs in LatAm due to limited Spanish-language technical education, economic barriers, and weak communities. Aiken simplifies development, but universities lack structured training.
solution: Cursos técnicos certificados de 20 horas en 4 universidades (Ecuador, Bolivia, Paraguay, Perú) utilizando Aiken con proyectos prácticos y una comunidad de exalumnos
title: University Network: Aiken Development Program for LatAm

problem: In Bolivia, less than 2% use crypto and blockchain knowledge is scarce. Amid crisis, young people seek value protection but lack digital financial education, widening the regional gap.
solution: An educational program at UPB Santa Cruz aims to train university students in blockchain and the use of Cardano as a real tool for transactions and value preservation in today’s economy.
title: University Workshops for Making Payments with Cardano

problem: Low awareness and engagement among unreached Ethiopian youths regarding Cardano blockchain, decentralized governance and Project Catalyst, limiting local adoption and participation.
solution: Host 3 conferences in Addis Ababa & Hawassa to engage 500+ Ethiopian youths, onboarding them to Cardano, decentralized governance, and Project Catalyst with local partnerships.
title: Unlocking Blockchain Potential:Youth Engagement in Ethiopia

problem: Kenya is open to blockchain, yet Cardano has limited visibility in universities. Students lack structured, engaging opportunities to learn and build on Cardano.
solution: We will organize a 3-day student hackathon in Nairobi with workshops, mentorship, and project challenges to introduce Cardano, inspire innovation, and onboard student talent.
title: Unlocking Cardano in Kenya: Student Innovation Hackathon

problem: SPOs and delegators lack tools to forecast ADA + NIGHT dual rewards or understand reserve, subsidy, and utilization. Awareness of NIGHT rewards among delegators is low.
solution: Build a web dashboard where SPOs and delegators can project ADA + NIGHT rewards, test scenarios, and learn with visuals, increasing awareness and adoption of Midnight dual rewards.
title: Unlocking Dual Rewards with ADA + NIGHT

problem: There is a need for game engine-based plugins to support Cardano and be available to the public. And it must generate and restore wallets on the device, without the dependency on a blockchain provider
solution: We want to enhance an unreal engine plugin thats available, make it production ready. Contains blueprint exposed code for connecting to various providers and tools (Blockfrost, Koios, Ogmios, etc)
title: Unreal Engine Plugin with Multi-providers (GameFi Dev Tool)

problem: Developers lack a simple, effective tool to debug Plutus contracts. This slows down development, increases errors, and raises the risk of unsafe dApps entering the Cardano ecosystem.
solution: We will build open source UPLC Debugger CLI with step-through execution by instruction, stack/memory tracking, error localization. This will make Plutus development faster, and easier to debug.
title: UPLC Stepper — The Cardano Smart Contract Debugger

problem: We want to solve Accra’s growing traffic congestion caused by private cars and inefficient local transport, by providing a comfortable, affordable, and eco-friendly shared bus platform.
solution: A digital platform connecting commuters to 10–14 seater buses on key routes, reducing traffic, saving time, cutting costs, and offering comfort over trotros and ride-hailing.
title: UrbanLink

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: Most crypto users are locked out of Cardano’s ecosystem, limiting adoption and growth. Without multi-chain access for leading dApps, Cardano cannot realize its full potential
solution: We will build cross-chain support so MetaMask, Phantom, and other users can trade perps on Strike, driving adoption and liquidity to position Cardano as a leading DeFi hub.
title: USDC + USDT perps on Cardano: extend Strike for multi-chain

problem: Many small creators and local artists find it hard to use today’s NFT marketplaces. The platforms are often too expensive, too complex, made for big projects not for common people. We want to fix that
solution: We’re building a simple and affordable NFT platform where local creators can mint and trade NFTs easily using Cardano’s low-fee system.
title: UTXO-based NFT Marketplace for Micro-Communities

problem: UTxO debugging is slow and opaque: current explorers focus on transactions and lack time-travel views. Devs can’t easily see which UTxOs were added/removed/changed or export clear visuals for docs
solution: We will build an open-source webapp that turns tx history into a contract-centric UTxO timeline with time-travel debugging, highlighting adds/removes/changes and exporting visuals for docs/audits.
title: UTxO Timeline Graph: Visual Time-Travel Debugging for Devs

problem: Organizations must build UVerify certificate templates from scratch, slowing adoption and adding costs. Many still see it as just a UI, missing its power to unlock fast Cardano use cases.
solution: Research-backed template library with ready-to-use certificate designs cuts deployment from weeks to hours, lowers entry barriers, and highlights UVerify’s potential as a full dApp platform.
title: UVerify Template Library for Cardano Certificates

problem: Web3 assets risk loss: keys get hacked, hardware wallets tricked, multisig is hard, custody kills sovereignty. Our 2FA vault uses wallet + Identity Oracle (TOTP, WebAuthn) for secure control.
solution: A portable, non-custodial 2FA vault for Cardano, supporting TOTP, WebAuthn, and Google login for easy onboarding, preserving self-custody, while exploring ZKP for decentralization and anonymity
title: Vaulti: The multi auth Cardano Vault

problem:
- Many users don’t fully understand Cardano assets & on-chain data
- Frequent balance checks via wallet app is a very risky way
- 3rd party Tool/explorers might reveal user IP, wallet, balance...
solution: Provide learning resources, guides, and documentation for creating a secure wallet self-tracking via Email and Telegram. We will also offer instructions on how to explore public Cardano API sources,
title: [VCC] Cardano asset tracker - Privacy, Easy and Free

problem:
Bringing the data economy to Cardano requires a trustless mechanism to verify off-chain data.

Our specification defines peer-to-peer IPFS communication for trustless off-chain data retrieval.
solution: We are creating a specification that defines how clients and Verifiable Decentralized IPFS Clusters can be used to design trustless data architectures for decentralized applications.
title: VDIC-Cardano: Verifiable IPFS Clusters for Cardano

problem: Cardano newcomers see long addresses, jargon, and investment hype before they can simply send a few ADA. No wallet gives instant setup, clear self-custody, and easy transfers to a phone number/email.
solution: Develop a trustworthy, beginner-focused, Cardano wallet mobile app with simple onboarding, immediate seed words, basic funding instructions, sending of ADA to phone/email contacts.
title: Vendano: Contact‑based Cardano wallet (iOS + Android)

problem: Cardano lacks consistent “blood flow” (small P2P sends). New users can’t find people to pay: no phone/email-to-address ecosystem exists, and there’s no quick way to seed it with current Cardano users.
solution: Distribute free blind‑bag NFT + Hosky reward cards at 100 US stores (10 stores within 10 US cities), and capture phone/emails to drive app installs and small initial ADA transactions.
title: Vendano: Physical HOSKY/NFT Card Campaign (10 US Cities)

problem: Cardano has a reputation for being difficult to build upon, but with the advent of a suite of easy-to-use ecosystem tools this is simply not true anymore.
solution: This proposal will publish the entire codebase for the Verifair dApp. Verifair demonstrates non-custodial, decentralized and verifiably fair gaming using on-chain entropy.
title: Verifair - Trustless Gaming Apps

problem: Scientific publishing is slow, opaque, and costly, controlled by gatekeepers.  Researchers lack transparent, open-access platforms to share and verify work globally.
solution: Veriscience is a blockchain platform for open, transparent scientific publishing, using on-chain records, decentralized storage, and video verification to ensure trust and access for all.
title: VeriScience: Decentralized Publishing & Peer review on ADA

problem: On the Cardano blockchain, a significant challenge is the lack of a standardized solution for verifying that a given address corresponds to the specific smart contract code.
solution: Cardano lacks a trustless way to verify if a smart contract address matches claimed code. VeriScript enables reliable verification through on-chain attestations and community oversight.
title: VeriScript - On-chain source code verification

problem: AI agents and tools cannot query Cardano data or interact with the blockchain, leaving Cardano invisible to the AI ecosystem while competitors rush to integrate AI capabilities.
solution: We will enable AI agents to explore Cardano through an MCP server, allowing Claude users and developers to query blockchain data and build AI-powered applications for Cardano.
title: VESPR: AI Bridge to Cardano 🤖 | For Claude, GPT & AI Agents

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: 20% of crypto is permanently lost due to seed phrases. Despite VESPR's seamless onboarding, users still face confusion, fund loss risk, and cross-device friction, blocking Web2 adoption.
solution: We'll enable wallet recovery via passkeys and social login (Google, Apple, etc), onboarding new users with familiar Web2 authentication while maintaining self-custody through cryptographic innovation.
title: VESPR Keyless: Self-Custody Without Seed Phrases

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: 61% of VESPR’s 200M+ ADA is inactive or abstaining in governance. Complexity blocks participation, weakening Cardano’s decentralization and decision legitimacy.
solution: We will streamline governance in VESPR with intuitive DRep discovery and one-tap delegation, allowing 100M+ ADA delegation by converting inactive and abstaining holders into active participants.
title: VESPR: Mobile Governance - Activating 100M+ ADA

problem: Cardano lacks WalletConnect Flutter SDK while 70% of users prefer mobile for finance. Without this standard protocol, Cardano dApps can't effectively reach mobile users, limiting ecosystem growth.
solution: We will enable all Cardano Flutter apps to implement WalletConnect by building open-source SDK, establishing industry-standard dApp connections for Cardano's mobile-first future.
title: VESPR: WalletConnect Cardano Flutter SDK & VESPR Integration

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: Cardano users lack direct stable-to-stable swaps inside wallets, forcing costly multi-step swaps and leaving profits on the table.
solution: Integrate stable-swap aggregation directly into VESPR + DexHunter, cutting fees and streamlining stablecoin trading where users already swap most.
title: VESPR x DexHunter: Stable-Swaps Aggregation 💱

problem: Veterinary clinics can't share patient data for research due to privacy concerns, limiting valuable insights that could improve animal healthcare outcomes across the industry.
solution: VetShare uses Midnight Network's zero-knowledge proofs to enable veterinary clinics to share research insights without exposing individual patient data, preserving privacy.
title: VetShare ZKP 🕛 - Veterinary Research Network on Midnight

problem: Developers expect vibe-coding tools when building any app — but popular AI models aren’t trained on Cardano code so vibe-coding for Cardano is impossible, preventing fast iteration and marketability
solution: Integrate our no-code platform with a custom-trained AI model that understands our Cardano building blocks, enabling anyone to create apps that interact with the Cardano ecosystem
title: Vibe-coding Cardano Apps in No-code Environment

problem: Vietnamese people need a reliable, transparent platform to connect, find jobs and collaborate globally. This is also a practical need of many other communities around the world.
solution:
We propose VietAssist MVP, a Cardano-based platform enabling:
-Job board for domestic & global opportunities.
-Matching between individuals or businesses.
-Trust score using simple smart contracts.
title: VietAssist.Net: Matching jobs and businesses on the Cardano

problem: There is currently a lack of a high-quality localized educational curriculum for Cardano development and developer-focused activities within the Vietnam Web3 Landscape.
solution: Our solution involves developing a comprehensive curriculum for Cardano developers by tech experts, coupled with a hackathon and mentoring/coaching to boost developer activities in Vietnam.
title: Vietnam Cardano Developer Boot Camp & Hackathon 2025

problem: Vietnam builders struggle to enter Cardano due to steep learning curves, unfamiliar languages and limited resources. Instead of asking “what to build", they must first figure out how to start building
solution: We will host a Cardano Ideathon in Vietnam to spark builder and developer creativity, helping them create new and breakthrough products on Cardano.
title: Vietnam Cardano Ideathon 2026

problem: Cardano awareness and education among university students in Vietnam remains low. We aim to close this gap and drive ADA adoption by introducing Cardano through targeted campus programs
solution: We’ll host 6 workshops and 6 meetups across Vietnam’s top universities to onboard students into Cardano, build a nationwide community network, and strengthen Cardano’s presence in education.
title: Vietnam Unitour: Cardano Growth in Uni & Student Onboarding

problem: The student community in Vietnam is still limited in Blockchain awareness, which limits their ability to participate in contributing, developing and building the Cardano ecosystem.
solution: Organize 10 workshops at major universities in Vietnam to introduce the Cardano ecosystem to students, lecturers and programmers. Inspire and introduce development opportunities in the ecosystem.
title: Vietnam University Cardano Workshop & Onboarding Series

problem: Aiken materials exist globally, yet lack a structured, Vietnamese-language learning path. Developers must navigate scattered docs, making onboarding inefficient
solution: Create the first open-access Vietnamese Aiken onboarding curriculum guide users from setup to deployment with clear explanations, examples, and available in PDF, web, GitHub formats
title: Vietnamese Aiken Onboarding Resource for Developers

problem: Ghana's internet penetration at only 45% and high costs limiting student access to online education .Traditional WiFi  with centralized ISPs dominate pricing this is also across Sub-Saharan Africa
solution: Village Connect DEPIN  WiFi-sharing marketplace on Cardano enabling Hosts to monetize surplus internet capacity through secure, time-limited access sessions.
title: Village Connect: Africas First Wifi Sharing DEPIN

problem: Environmental degradation harms our planet through widespread litter pollution. Lack of transparent, incentivized, and localized cleanup efforts limits effective community action and impact.
solution: A Cardano-based dApp connecting donors, stewards, and volunteers to fund, verify, and reward localized cleanup efforts transparently and securely on-chain.
title: Viridian Mosaic: Reward Environmental Impact

problem: Non-technical entrepreneurs and small businesses cannot deploy smart contracts due to complex programming, limiting Cardano accessibility.
solution: Build drag-and-drop smart contract builder with templates, real-time Aiken code generation, and one-click deployment for Cardano.
title: Visual Aiken Smart Contract Builder (No-Code Platform)

problem: Cardano lacks non-USD stablecoins, limiting its reach to European users and institutions. This creates a barrier to broader adoption, especially in the EU - a promising market growing post-MiCA.
solution: We propose launching VEUR, VCHF, VGBP stablecoins on Cardano to expand currency choice, reduce FX friction, and support broader DeFi and institutional adoption across Europe.
title: VNX - Licensed European non-usd stablecoins for Cardano

problem: The rapidly increasing Africa community requires that Cardano documents and news be presented in a more reliable, understandable, and effective way in local Africa languages.
solution: We introduce Cardano Africa TikTok Channel to deliver reliable, engaging content, showcasing Africa’s diverse cultures and promoting blockchain innovation.
title: Voices of Africa on TikTok

problem: African creatives face piracy, low royalties, and limited global reach. This proposal solves the storytelling gap with a docu-series, onboarding them to Cardano's protective blockchain solutions.
solution: "Voices of Cardano Africa," a 5 part documentary series showcasing African creatives using Cardano to improve their livelihoods. Episodes will have educational clips and subtitles in local language.
title: Voices of Cardano Africa

problem: Low turnout and idle SPO/DRep delegations leave large portions of Catalyst voting power unused, weakening governance legitimacy and decision quality.
solution: VoteScope AI activates idle voting power by tracking turnout, mapping engagement trends, and nudging delegations with reputational rewards while preserving privacy.
title: VoteScope AI: Voter Turnout Intelligence for SPOs & DReps

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: Cardano DeFi growth is limited by complex liquidity farming, high barriers for new users, and low risk transparency for liquidity. This can discourage participation and slow ecosystem adoption.
solution: Auto-Harvester simplifies Cardano DeFi by letting users access multiple pools in one step, increasing on-chain liquidity, cutting congestion, and making yield farming more accessible.
title: VyFi Auto-Harvester

problem: Web2 streaming is outdated: users want to interact, shape culture, be rewarded not exploited, while rights holders still struggle with slow, opaque royalty collection.
solution: W3BFLIX brings streaming to messaging apps (3.5Bn+ users in 2025), using Cardano smart contracts for payments, royalties & NFTs, enabling fair Watch/Share/Create-to-Earn and mass blockchain adoption.
title: W3BFLIX

problem: WAirdrop: The first free Cardano tool to airdrop ADA, NFTs & tokens to unlimited wallets and supplies, empowering creators to run campaigns reaching unlimited users.
solution: WAirdrop offers the first free Cardano tool to airdrop ADA, NFTs & tokens to unlimited wallets, linking with campaigns to reach unlimited users.
title: WAirdrop: One platform, endless drops

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: Cardano adoption is limited as users lack engaging, gamified experiences that attract Web2 and cross chain communities
solution: A walk2earn app that uses gamification and GameFi to drive Cardano adoption, engaging Web2 and cross chain users through fun, rewarding experiences
title: Walkers - Gamification for Mass Adoption!

problem: Cardano seems too complex for companies; without hands-on demos, their staff ignore it. We need a playful learning experience that turns abstract blockchain ideas into concrete, shareable skills.
solution: A team-building game where employees cut virtual CO₂, solve eco-challenges, and explore Cardano’s green projects, learning PoS, NFTs, and real-world impact through play and shared resources.
title: Wallet Quest on Cardano - Teambuilding Corporate

problem: Web3 and Cardano lacks consistent,city-level on-ramps at major crypto weeks;entrepreneurial enthusiams rarely converts into momentum when it should, web3 people can't find their people easily to build
solution: Launch W3CN flagship and builder Week events: wallet & startups thrive, founder clinics, curated meetups, and public kits—creating repeatable city hubs that turn enthusiasm into teams and momentum.
title: Web3 Cites Network x Cardano

problem: Gaming industry lacks transparent, decentralized platforms for organizing tournaments. Existing solutions are centralized and often lack trust due to manual processes and opaque reward systems.
solution: A Web3 GameFi platform on Cardano, delivering transparent, decentralized gaming tournaments with reward distribution via smart contracts. It will start featuring retro-style games.
title: Web3 Platform for Gaming Tournaments

problem: Traditional travel booking lacks blockchain benefits like Crypto payment, temper proof reviews and easily convertable rewards. Blockchain community needs a dedicated hotel booking platform for them.
solution: Web3Hotels.com MVP: A Hotel booking platform for Blockchain Commnunity, enabled with Cypto Payment, Loyalty Rewards in ADA and Verified Reviews on Cardano
title: Web3Hotels.com - Cardano based Hotel Booking Platform MVP

problem: The myth of water scarcity ignores vast renewable primary water reserves deep underground. Lack of awareness, funding, and public engagement keeps this solution out of reach.
solution: Raise awareness of the primary water paradigm through a well-drilling documentary, funded by Project Catalyst, with NFT tickets & investment NFTs sustaining training, equipment, and future operations
title: Wells of Truth: Unlocking Primary Water Through NFTs & Web3

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: Lack of transparent and trustable price data limits agricultural finance, trade decisions, and food security interventions across developing countries.
solution: Create a blockchain-based pricing oracle on Cardano using WFP's global market data from 1,800+ markets across 59 countries, making price data more acessible, timely and reusable.
title: WFP Price Ledger: Democratizing Market Data with Blockchain

problem: The growing luxury resale market exposes brands to counterfeits, losing client relationships and data, harming brand image, and missing user experiences matching luxury standards.
solution: White-label, blockchain-powered luxury resale marketplace, brand-managed to leverage blockchain’s advantages while delivering a seamless, premium user experience.
title: White-Label Decentralized Luxury Resale Marketplace

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: Builders on Cardano lack a fast, ready-to-use auction service. Current options are slow, costly, and complex, blocking innovation and raising building costs in NFTs, gaming, and DeFi.
solution: MLabs + Ikigai will deliver an open-source, Hydra-powered whitelabel auction house—turnkey, fast, and customizable for any builder on Cardano.
title: Whitelabel Hydra Auctions for Gaming & Defi (MLabs + Ikigai)

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: Cardano lacks a fast, solution for real-time apps and games. Existing tools are slow, costly or custodial. Wildcard offers a scalable L2 with asset migration to unlock Cardano’s full potential.
solution: Wildcard is a fast, non-custodial Layer 2 for Cardano, enabling real-time asset use, cross-chain migration, and scalable SDKs for games and apps, keeping users in control of their digital assets.
title: Wildcard for Cardano: Enabling Seamless Web3 Gaming

challenge: F14: Cardano Use Case: Partners & Products
problem: Manual processes and fragmented tools challenge wineries in Moldova and globally; lack of traceability, compliance, and DLT adoption hinders efficiency, trust, and export competitiveness.
solution: WineOpSys - Intelligent Winery Operations Platform: Modernizing Viticulture with Integrated ERP and Blockchain Traceability.
title: WineOpSys via Originate - ERP with supply chain tracking

problem: Absence of standardized LLM benchmarks for Cardano’s smart contract languages hinders the advancement of a robust and efficient AI-assisted development ecosystem.
solution: Wolfram will build an open-source framework to benchmark LLMs on interpreting and generating Cardano smart contracts, measuring correctness, syntax compliance, vulnerability and explain-ability.
title: Wolfram: AI Benchmarks for Cardano

problem: Cardano lacks a unified MCP server for LLM-powered development, governance insights, and smart contract tools, slowing innovation and limiting access for developers and voters.
solution: Build a Cardano MCP Server for AI-assisted contract coding, Plutus doc search, and Catalyst governance insights, accessible in MCP hosts like Claude, VS Code, and other IDEs
title: Wolfram Cardano MCP Server: Smart Contracts & Catalyst

problem: Cardano currently lacks a unified KPI dashboard that integrates protocol, financial, and ecosystem metrics WITH convenient access to DeFi price feeds.
solution: Build a comprehensive dashboard that aggregates these metrics and doubles as an onramp into DeFi price feeds, making data both accessible and actionable.
title: Wolfram: EchoFeed Dashboard

problem: Plutus knowledge is scattered, hard to search, and often unreliable. Developers need a system that generates precise, citation-backed answers from curated Plutus resources.
solution: Plutus RAG uses retrieval-augmented AI to deliver fast, accurate, citation-backed answers from curated Plutus docs, CIPs, and forums, helping developers build and audit smart contracts efficiently.
title: Wolfram Plutus RAG: The AI-Powered Knowledge Engine

problem: Women remain underrepresented in blockchain. Lack of access to education, mentorship, and networks hinders their inclusion in the Cardano ecosystem.

title: Women of Web3 Support Channels

problem: In Ethiopia, women face cultural, educational, and economic barriers to blockchain, limiting their access to Cardano’s empowering tools and opportunities.
solution: Women on Chain Ethiopia will offer Cardano literacy, financial workshops, and access points for women, with safe spaces, mentorship, and Amharic content tailored to Ethiopian women’s needs.

problem: Talented women developers in Ecuador often lack spaces to collaborate, explore blockchain, and turn their expertise into innovative tools that create real social impact
solution: Empower 50+ women developers in Ecuador through a Cardano-focused hackathon, providing hands-on blockchain training, expert mentorship, building strong networks and practical  for real-world impact
title: Women’s Blockchain Hackathon Ecuador

problem: The web2 is based on wordpress based websites that host all the real estate assets.  Hence they cannot do onboarding of real world assets onto blockchain.
solution: We want to provide a tokenization module for the web2 sites that can easily connect via this module to tokenize their assets and enable them to transition to web3 based tokenized investment of assets.
title: Wordpress module for tokenization of real estate

problem: Centralized digital out-of-home advertising suffers from high costs, limited flexibility and poor analytics. The industry needs a more decentralized, data-driven solution to enhance accessibility.
solution:
WorldAds mounts smart displays on vehicles to form a distributed ad network. 

On-chain NFTs represent ownership, while smart contracts power transparent, efficient, data-rich outdoor advertising.
title: WorldAds: Cardano-Powered DePIN Ads On Vehicle Roofs

problem: Poor user habits, like saving mnemonics as screenshots or digital notes, risk wallet hacks on Cardano. The payment process is complex, and direct offline P2P transactions are not supported.
solution: We will develop an Android wallet integrated with one-touch payment and offline payment capabilities for areas with no internet or poor connectivity, along with a mechanism to resist mnemonic attacks.
title: X150-Valkyrie Wallet: One-Touch & Offline Pay, Mnemonic Safe

problem: Many Africans lack motivation and tangible incentives to learn Web3. Without local rewards or proof-of-progress, education feels disconnected from real-world value or outcomes.
solution: We'll launch a learn-to-earn program rewarding learners with ADA for completing Web3 classes, quizzes, and wallet setup—boosting motivation, engagement, and Cardano adoption across Africa.
title: Yeneta Learn2Earn: On-Chain Rewards-Web3 Learners in Africa

problem: Cardano lacks cultural touchpoints, this affects mainstream adoption. Our proposed Supper Clubs transform meals into entry points, giving people daily reasons to learn, connect, and transact with ADA.
solution: Weekly blockchain supper clubs in London where guests share food, culture & community while learning Cardano, setting up wallets, and paying in ADA in a fun, welcoming way.
title: Young Nola Blockchain Supper Series: Culture.Cardano.Cuisine

problem: Crypto Inheritance does not work. Current solutions are either complex, limit your control over your asset, introduce risks, or are not legally compliant. Traditional Inheritance has high costs.
solution: Imagine having a user-friendly wallet that on top of regular features, uses smart contracts to allow you to create rules for inheritance and a recovery plan for your Crypto. With our Dapp, you can.
title: Your Self-Custodial Blockchain Will on Cardano - GenWealth

problem: Lack of educational and informative content about Cardano in the Afaan Oromo language hinders engagement, knowledge sharing, and participation of the Oromo-speaking community in the Cardano ecosystem.
solution: We will create high-quality YouTube videos in Afaan Oromo, providing clear, accurate, and accessible education on Cardano. This will empower the Oromo-speaking population to understand cardano.
title: YouTube Channel for the Oromo-speaking Community

problem: Cardano users must choose between costly, less convenient hardware wallets or less secure software wallets. YubiKey offers a secure, portable, affordable alternative.
solution: Open-source tool enabling Cardano private key storage on YubiKey and secure signing of Cardano transactions.
title: Yubikey Cardano Wallet

problem: Attendance and event momentum are down; incentives are hard to track and easy to game. Students need a digital-native reward inside a tool they already use—CalOne.
solution: ZapCoin rewards verified student attendance with a Cardano-native token, redeemable for campus discounts and perks, while providing organizers real-time engagement metrics and ROI insights.
title: ZapCoin x CalOne — Cardano-Powered Student Engagement Token

problem: Tenants must reveal sensitive documents to prove eligibility (income, age), creating privacy risks and inefficiency. No privacy-preserving verification exists today.
solution: Build a Cardano-based SSI wallet extension using zero-knowledge proofs so tenants can prove eligibility (e.g. income ≤ threshold) without exposing personal data.
title: Zero-Knowledge Tenant Credentials using Veridian DID/VC

problem: Cardano lacks developer-focused AI tools for code generation, UX testing, and education workflows, slowing innovation compared to ecosystems with advanced dev support.
solution: Zeus AI SDK delivers dev-ready tools for code generation, testing, and education flows on Cardano—supercharging builders, boosting UX, and accelerating adoption across the ecosystem.
title: Zeus AI SDK: Supercharging Devs on Cardano

problem: Most developers lack the skills to understand and implement zero-knowledge protocols effectively.
solution: We will deliver and record a three-day course on zero-knowledge protocols and their application to Cardano, taught by experts from Eryx, focusing on foundational concepts and practical skills in ZK.
title: ZK Bootcamp for Cardano by Eryx

problem: Mechanical designers lack secure ways to prove prior art or part differences without exposing CAD files, leading to IP theft risks and costly disputes.
solution: We will build ZK-CAD Vault: a privacy-preserving platform that lets designers prove prior art and part differences using zero-knowledge proofs without revealing CAD models.
title: ZK-CAD Prior-Art Vault

problem: Material for writing ZK DApps on Cardano is not easy to find and developers are struggling to build on Cardano ZK applications
solution: An ebook that collects all the information for new developers and resources in order to interact with zero knowledge circuits and smart contracts on Cardano
title: ZK from zero on Cardano [ebook] by elRaulito

problem: Cardano uses a seed-phrase for authentication, which generates a public-private key pair. This flow is cumbersome even for blockchain-fluent users. The user has to safeguard it, or risk losing access.
solution: We propose implementing an OpenID login flow to facilitate onboarding of less tech-savvy potential Cardano users, leveraging ZK proofs. Any dApp will be able to use this new login flow.
title: ZK Login in Cardano - Eryx

problem: Cardano lacks private and negotiable peer-to-peer loans. Borrowers must overshare data; lenders lack reliable risk signals without centralized intermediaries.
solution: A ZK-P2P Library where Midnight verifies zero-knowledge loan eligibility proofs and Cardano executes loan settlements, repayments and term negotiations with no Personally Identifiable Information
title: ZK-P2P Lending with Midnight ZKPs; Private Loans Cardano Lib

problem: Cardano lacks native USDC/USDT. Liquidity is fragmented and depends on custodial bridges. A non-custodial, zk-verified bridge will bring USDC/USDT liquidity to Cardano and unlock DeFi growth.
solution: A non-custodial, zk-verified bridge that moves USDC/USDT across EVM, Cardano, and Midnight. Verify finality without trusted relays; liquidity is pooled and programmatically rebalanced
title: ZK-Stables: USDC/USDT Non Custodial Bridge

problem: Freedom of speech is under threat. Citizens fear signing petitions due to surveillance. Web2 platforms lack anonymity, can be blocked, and risk fake signatures, eroding trust.
solution: We will build ZKPetition a Midnight-based platform for anonymous petitions. Using ZK-Proofs it verifies signatures eligibility while hiding identities, ensuring trust and single-sign security
title: ZKPetition: Privacy-Powered Voices
